definition_zh: 纪念碑；纪念馆；纪念的；追悼会；陈述书
definition_en: a statue, building or ceremony that keeps a person or event in public memory; also an adjective meaning held in remembrance
core_image: 一块立在草地上的石碑，碑面朝着一排常来放花的人
scene: 清明前后，山坡上那块石碑前又摆了几束野花，碑上的名字被雨水冲得发亮。 A small memorial stands at the bend of the road where the bridge once crossed the stream.
sceneCN: 这里 memorial 是「纪念碑」（第 1 个义项：为使人不忘记而立的石碑）；句意为道路拐弯处立着一座小小的纪念碑，那里曾经有桥跨过溪水。

pos.zh: 纪念碑；纪念馆；追悼会；陈述书

derivatives.zh: 由 memorial 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「纪念；为……立传」
由 memorialize 再加 -ation 构成，义为「纪念的行为」
由 memorial 加 -ly 构成，义为「以纪念的方式」

senses.title: A structure that keeps a person or event in mind
senses.definition: a statue, building or stone put up so that people do not forget a person or an event
senses.definitionCN: 为使人不忘记某人或某事而立起的雕像、建筑或石碑
senses.example: A stone memorial stands where the school once was.
senses.exampleCN: 学校旧址上立着一座石碑。
senses.why: Latin memor means mindful, so a memorial is first of all an object placed on the ground to hold a memory in one spot for everyone who passes.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 memor 意为「记得的」，所以 memorial 首先是一件落在地上的物件，把记忆固定在一处，交给每个经过的人。

senses.title: Existing to honour the dead
senses.definition: used of an object, day or event that exists in order to honour someone who has died
senses.definitionCN: 形容某件物品、某个日子或某场活动是为悼念逝者而设
senses.example: The memorial garden was planted with white roses along its low wall.
senses.exampleCN: 那座纪念园沿着矮墙种满了白玫瑰。
senses.why: Once the purpose of the stone is folded into an adjective, the word stops pointing at the object and starts describing the mood of everything arranged around it.
senses.whyCN: 一旦石头的用途被折叠进形容词，这个词就不再指向物件本身，而开始形容围绕它安排的一切所带的气氛。

senses.title: A ceremony held so that people remember together
senses.definition: a service or gathering at which people recall someone or something as a group
senses.definitionCN: 让人们聚在一起共同追忆某人或某事的仪式或聚会
senses.example: The memorial lasted an hour, and nobody spoke of anything else.
senses.exampleCN: 追悼会开了一个小时，没有人谈别的事。
senses.why: Memory in Latin is a private act, but when a group gathers to keep it, the word stretches from the stone to the hour spent standing beside it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里的记忆是私人的行为，可一旦一群人聚起来共同守着它，词就从那块石头延伸到站在石头旁度过的那一个小时。

senses.title: A written statement laid before a government
senses.definition: a formal document that sets out facts or a request and is handed to someone in authority
senses.definitionCN: 把事实或请求写明、递交给掌权者的正式文书
senses.example: The merchants sent a memorial to the council asking for lower tolls.
senses.exampleCN: 商人们向议会递交了一份陈述书，请求降低通行费。
senses.why: A written record is memory made public, so this word once named a paper that kept an argument standing in front of those who held power.
senses.whyCN: 书面记录是把记忆公开，所以这个词曾经指一份文书，让理由一直立在掌权者眼前。

intro.en: Memorial descends from the Latin word for mindful, and it travelled through the language of memory into English as both a stone and an adjective of remembrance.
intro.cn: memorial 源自拉丁语中表示「记得」的词，经过一整套关于记忆的词汇进入英语，既指一块石头，也作表示悼念的形容词。

items.en: Memor was the Latin adjective for mindful or remembering, and it was used of a person who kept something in mind.
items.cn: memor 是拉丁语里表示「记得的、留心的」形容词，用来形容把某事放在心上的人。

items.en: Memoria named memory itself, both the faculty and the thing remembered, and it fed a large family of words.
items.cn: memoria 指记忆本身，既是记忆力，也是被记住的事，并派生出一大批词。

items.en: Memorialis was formed on memoria with a suffix meaning relating to, so it meant belonging to memory.
items.cn: memorialis 由 memoria 加表示「与……有关」的后缀构成，意为属于记忆的。

items.en: Old French passed the word to English, where it first named a record or a written statement as much as a stone.
items.cn: 古法语把这个词传给英语，早期它既指石碑，也同样指记录或书面陈述。

items.en: Modern English keeps the stone, the ceremony and the adjective, while the written-statement sense survives mainly in historical and official use.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了石碑、仪式与形容词三个用法，而「书面陈述」一义主要留在历史与公文语境里。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the Latin word for memory through its English family; the near-meaning group gathers the objects and words used to honour what has been lost.
note.cn: 形近组沿着拉丁语中表示「记忆」的词串起它的英语词族；近义组收用来向逝去之物致敬的物件与说法。

entries.definition: The ability to keep things in mind, and something kept that way.
entries.definitionCN: 把事物留在心里的能力，以及被这样留住的东西。

entries.definition: To learn something by heart until it can be repeated.
entries.definitionCN: 把内容记到能复述为止。

entries.definition: Worth being remembered because it is unusual or moving.
entries.definitionCN: 因不寻常或动人而值得被记住的。

entries.definition: A short note written so that a point is not forgotten.
entries.definitionCN: 为防止要点被忘掉而写下的简短记录。

entries.definition: A building or statue built to keep a person or event famous.
entries.definitionCN: 为让某人或某事长留人心而建的建筑或雕像。

entries.definition: The act of keeping someone in mind, often in a ceremony.
entries.definitionCN: 把某人留在心里的行为，常出现在仪式中。

entries.definition: Something said or done to show respect and admiration.
entries.definitionCN: 为表达敬意与钦佩而说的话或做的事。

entries.definition: Made or held in order to honour a person or event.
entries.definitionCN: 为纪念某人或某事而制作或举行的。

normalIntro.en: One Latin root for remembering runs through this whole family, and the word leans on it whether it names a stone, a service or a piece of paper.
normalIntro.cn: 一个表示「记得」的拉丁词根贯穿整族词，无论是石碑、仪式还是一纸文书，这个词都靠它立住。

normal.en: Memor is Latin for mindful, so a memorial is an object whose only job is to keep something in mind.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 memor 意为记得，所以 memorial 是一件唯一职责就是让人记住某事的物件。

normal.en: Memory, memorize and memorable all sit on the same root, which is why they look and sound so close.
normal.cn: memory、memorize 与 memorable 都长在同一个词根上，所以它们的样子与读音都这么近。

normal.en: The adjective memorial keeps the noun's purpose but drops the object, so a memorial service honours without any stone present.
normal.cn: 形容词 memorial 保留名词的用途却丢掉物件，所以 memorial service 可以在没有石头的情况下完成悼念。

normal.en: Old use of memorial for a petition survives in the phrase memorial to the council, where paper replaces stone.
normal.cn: memorial 指请愿书的旧用法还活在向议会递交文书的说法里，纸取代了石头。

normal.en: Memorial Day is capitalized because it names a fixed public holiday, not any stone you happen to pass.
normal.cn: Memorial Day 首字母大写，因为它指一个固定的公共节日，而不是你路过的一块石头。

abstract.en: Stone is the slowest thing a town owns, so putting a name on it is a way of asking it to outlast every voice that could say the name.
abstract.cn: 石头是一座城镇拥有的最慢的东西，把名字刻上去，就是请它比所有能念出这个名字的嗓子活得更久。

abstract.en: A ceremony and a slab do the same work: both hold a memory still so that a crowd can look at it together.
abstract.cn: 仪式与石板做同一件事：都把一段记忆按住，好让一群人能一起看着它。

abstract.en: The word began as an adjective of the mind and ended up on stone, which says that remembering always wants something solid to lean on.
abstract.cn: 这个词起于一个关于心智的形容词，最后落到石头上，说明记忆总想找点坚实的东西靠着。

examples.en: A memorial was built beside the river for the men lost at sea.
examples.cn: 河边立起一座纪念碑，纪念那些在海上失踪的人。

examples.en: The memorial service ended with a single bell.
examples.cn: 追悼仪式在一声钟响中结束。

examples.en: Each spring the town holds a small memorial in the old square.
examples.cn: 每年春天，镇上都在旧广场举行一场小小的纪念活动。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「莫忘」——碑立在那里，就是叫人莫忘；记住 memorial 是纪念碑。

root: 拉丁语 memor（记得的）+ -ia（名词词尾）→ memoria（记忆）→ 晚期拉丁语 memorialis（属于记忆的）→ 古法语 memorial → 英语 memorial。

sensesIntro.en: The core is an object or act that keeps memory fixed. It splits into the stone, the adjective of honour, the shared ceremony, and the paper that puts a case before power.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是把记忆固定住的物件或行为。它分出石碑、表示敬意的形容词、众人共办的仪式，以及把理由递到权力面前的文书。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stone standing in grass, with fresh flowers at its foot.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块立在草里的石碑，脚边放着新花。

branches.en: a stone slab under bare trees
branches.cn: 光秃的树下的一块石板

branches.en: white roses along a low wall
branches.cn: 矮墙边的一排白玫瑰

branches.en: people standing in a cold hall
branches.cn: 人们站在冷清的礼堂里

branches.en: a folded paper handed to a clerk
branches.cn: 一份折好的文书递给书记员

branches.en: a name cut into stone so that it outlasts a voice
branches.cn: 刻进石头的名字，比声音活得更久

intro.en: The word is a Latin noun of memory fitted with a suffix of relation, and English later added endings that turn it into a verb and an adverb.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语中表示记忆的名词加上一个表关系的后缀，英语后来又添上词尾，把它变成动词与副词。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

definition_en: wanting much more than you need
core_image: 一只手伸向堆得满满的盘子
scene: 那个贪婪的男孩拿走了所有糖果。 The greedy boy took all the sweets.
sceneCN: 这里 greedy 是「贪婪的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：那个贪婪的男孩拿走了所有糖果。

senses.title: Wanting too much
senses.definition: wanting much more than you need
senses.definitionCN: 想要远超所需之物的
senses.example: The greedy boy took all the sweets.
senses.exampleCN: 那个贪婪的男孩拿走了所有糖果。
senses.why: Excess desire is the core sense.
senses.whyCN: 过度的欲望是这个词的核心。

senses.title: Eating too much
senses.definition: eating more than your share
senses.definitionCN: 吃得超过自己应得的一份
senses.example: Don't be greedy; leave some for others.
senses.exampleCN: 别贪吃，给别人留一些。
senses.why: The oldest sense is about food and hunger.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项与食物和饥饿有关。

senses.title: Eager to have
senses.definition: very eager for something
senses.definitionCN: 非常渴望得到某物
senses.example: She was greedy for news of home.
senses.exampleCN: 她急切地想知道家里的消息。
senses.why: The desire can be intense without being wrong.
senses.whyCN: 这种渴望可以强烈而不带贬义。

intro.en: Greedy is an Old English word that first meant hungry.
intro.cn: greedy 是古英语词，最初意为饥饿的。

items.en: Grædig meant hungry or eager.
items.cn: grædig 意为饥饿的、渴望的。

items.en: Greedy kept the sense of wanting too much.
items.cn: greedy 保留了想要过多的含义。

items.en: It named both food and wealth.
items.cn: 它既形容贪吃，也形容贪财。

items.en: Greed developed as the matching noun.
items.cn: greed 作为对应名词发展起来。

items.en: The word now covers any strong craving.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖任何强烈的贪求。

note.en: Greedy is compared with look-alike words and words for wanting.
note.cn: 把 greedy 与形近词以及表示贪求的词作比较。

between black and white
to welcome someone
extremely greedy for money
always wanting more
very keen to do something

normalIntro.en: Greedy is hunger that forgets other people.
normalIntro.cn: greedy 是忘了别人的那种饥饿。

normal.en: Don't be so greedy.
normal.cn: 别这么贪心。

normal.en: The greedy dog ate everything.
normal.cn: 那只贪吃的狗把什么都吃了。

normal.en: He is greedy for money.
normal.cn: 他贪财。

normal.en: She was greedy for success.
normal.cn: 她渴望成功。

normal.en: Greedy eyes followed the gold.
normal.cn: 贪婪的目光追着金子。

abstract.en: Greedy hands hold nothing gently.
abstract.cn: 贪婪的手，握不住任何东西。

abstract.en: The more it eats, the hungrier it feels.
abstract.cn: 吃得越多，越觉得饿。

abstract.en: Enough is a word the greedy cannot hear.
abstract.cn: 「够了」这个词，贪婪者听不见。

examples.en: The greedy boy took all the sweets.
examples.cn: 那个贪婪的男孩拿走了所有糖果。

examples.en: Don't be greedy; leave some for others.
examples.cn: 别贪吃，给别人留一些。

examples.en: She was greedy for news of home.
examples.cn: 她急切地想知道家里的消息。

dict_mnemonic.text: greedy 是形容词「贪婪的」，名词是 greed，副词是 greedily；be greedy for 表示「贪求…」；注意与 green（绿色的）、grey（灰色的）区分。

root: 来自古英语 grædig（饥饿的、渴望的），核心义由生理的饥饿扩展到对财物、权力的过度贪求。

sensesIntro.en: Greedy means wanting too much, eating too much, or very eager for something.
sensesIntro.cn: greedy 指贪得无厌、贪吃，或非常渴望某物。

core.en: A hunger that never says enough.
core.cn: 一种从不说够了的饥饿。

branches.en: A hand sweeps the table clean.
branches.cn: 一只手把桌面扫空。

branches.en: A child takes the last piece twice.
branches.cn: 孩子把最后一块拿了两次。

branches.en: Eyes search for a letter from home.
branches.cn: 眼睛在寻找一封家书。

branches.en: Food and fortune feed the same hunger.
branches.cn: 食物与财富，喂养同一种饥饿。

branches.en: Wanting can be hunger or hope.
branches.cn: 渴望，可以是饥饿，也可以是希望。

intro.en: Greedy forms comparison, adverbs, and nouns.
intro.cn: greedy 构成比较级、副词和名词。

latinIntro.en: Greedy has no Latin root; it comes from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: greedy 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语。

items.example: He grew greedier with each win.
It was the greediest grab of all.
items.exampleCN: 那是所有抢夺中最贪婪的一次。
那个过分贪婪的商人失去了一切。

definition_zh: 水下的；在水中的；水下使用的
definition_en: lying, happening, or used below the surface of the sea, a lake, or a river
core_image: 一个人把头埋进清亮的水面以下，看见阳光在头顶碎成一片晃动的光斑
scene: 潜摄小组清晨出发，海面平静得像一块玻璃。 An underwater camera filmed the coral reef for two hours.
sceneCN: 这里 underwater 是「水下的」（第 1 个义项：位于水面以下）；句意为一台水下摄像机把珊瑚礁拍了两小时。沉到水面以下的那个世界，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 水下；水中部分（少见用法）

derivatives.zh: 由同义近形词构成，义为「海底的」
由拉丁语 sub-「在下」加 mergere「浸入」构成，义为「被水淹没的」

senses.title: Below the surface
senses.definition: situated or happening below the surface of a body of water
senses.definitionCN: 位于或发生在水体表面以下
senses.example: The divers spent an hour underwater looking for the wreck.
senses.exampleCN: 潜水员在水下待了一小时寻找那艘沉船。
senses.why: Under is beneath and water is water: the word simply puts one thing below the other.
senses.whyCN: under 是「在下面」，water 是「水」：这个词就是把一样东西放到另一样下面。

senses.title: Made for use down there
senses.definition: designed, built, or used for working below the surface
senses.definitionCN: 为在水面以下工作而设计、建造或使用的
senses.example: The crew lowered an underwater light to film the fish at night.
senses.exampleCN: 船员放下了一盏水下灯，在夜里拍鱼。
senses.why: Anything that has to work down there must survive pressure and water, so the word marks equipment by its place.
senses.whyCN: 凡要在那里工作的东西都得扛住水压与水，于是这个词以地点来标记器材。

senses.title: Swimming below the surface
senses.definition: moving, swimming, or staying beneath the surface rather than on it
senses.definitionCN: 在水面以下而非水面之上移动、游泳或停留
senses.example: Sea otters can swim underwater for several minutes at a time.
senses.exampleCN: 海獭一次能在水下游泳好几分钟。
senses.why: Used after a verb, the same word tells where the action happens.
senses.whyCN: 放在动词之后，同一个词说明动作发生在哪里。

senses.title: The submerged part
senses.definition: the part of a rock, hull, or structure that lies beneath the waterline
senses.definitionCN: 岩石、船体或建筑物位于水线以下的部分
senses.example: Engineers inspected the underwater of the pier for cracks.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师检查了桥墩水下部分是否有裂缝。
senses.why: The word can be turned into a noun for the hidden half of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 这个词可以名词化，指一样东西藏在水下的那一半。

senses.title: In debt: sunk below
senses.titleCN: 资不抵债：沉到水面以下
senses.definition: in the phrase underwater on a loan, owing more than the property is worth
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 underwater on a loan，指欠款超过抵押物价值
senses.example: After the flood the family was underwater on its mortgage.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水之后，这家的房贷已经资不抵债。
senses.why: Financially the image is exact: the borrower is below the line, and the water over his head is debt.
senses.whyCN: 在财务上这个比喻很贴切：借款人沉在水线以下，头顶的水就是债。

intro.en: Underwater is a transparent English compound of two native roots, first used when people began to write about diving and the sea floor.
intro.cn: underwater 是结构透明的英语复合词，两个部件都是本土词根，人们开始描写潜水与海底时才用起来。

items.en: Under is Old English under, beneath, and wæter is the native word for water.
items.cn: under 是古英语 under（在下面），wæter 是表示水的本土词。

items.en: Both words descend from Germanic forms, and they have stood side by side since the earliest English.
items.cn: 两个词都源自日耳曼语形式，自最早的英语起就并立使用。

items.en: In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries divers wrote of underwater work on wrecks and harbours.
items.cn: 十七与十八世纪，潜水员记录关于沉船与港口的水下作业时用了这个说法。

items.en: The nineteenth century added underwater cables, tunnels and photography.
items.cn: 十九世纪又添了水下电缆、隧道与水下摄影。

items.en: The word was later borrowed by finance for debt below the value line.
items.cn: 后来金融界借用了这个词，指价值线以下的债务。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers other compounds with under-; the near-meaning group gathers words for things below the surface with different scope.
note.cn: 形近组收其他以 under- 构成的复合词；近义组收表示水面以下事物的词，范围各有不同。

entries.definition: Below the surface of the ground, or the railway that runs there.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，义为「地下的」，也指地下铁路。

entries.definition: Below the surface of the sea; close to underwater but usually about the sea only.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「海底的」，与 underwater 接近，但通常只用于海。

entries.definition: Not letting water through; describes a material rather than a place.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「防水的」，描述材料而非位置。

entries.definition: Already started and in progress; the second half is way, not water.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「已开始的、进行中的」，后半部分是 way 而不是 water。

entries.definition: Further along a river in the direction the water flows.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词或副词，义为「下游的」，指沿水流方向更远处。

entries.definition: Completely covered by water; stresses the fact of being drowned rather than the place.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「被淹没的」，强调被水盖住的状况而非位置。

entries.definition: A vessel that travels below the surface; also an adjective for undersea things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词「潜艇」，也作形容词表示「海底的」。

entries.definition: Lying at the bottom, especially of a ship or a garden area set lower down.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「沉没的、下凹的」，多指沉船或下沉的庭院。

entries.definition: Of the open ocean far from land and far below the surface.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「深海的」，指远离陆地、水面很深的开放海域。

entries.definition: A formal adjective for life or activity below water; rare in everyday speech.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「水下的、水生的」，较正式，日常少见。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two plain English pieces and the real phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词的两个朴素英语部件，以及它真实出现的搭配。

normal.en: Under plus water: wherever the word goes, it names a place below the surface.
normal.cn: under 加 water：这个词无论怎么用，指的都是水面以下的位置。

normal.en: An underwater camera must survive pressure, so it is named by where it works.
normal.cn: 水下摄像机必须扛住水压，因此以工作地点命名。

normal.en: Swim underwater uses the word as an adverb after the verb.
normal.cn: swim underwater 把这个词当副词放在动词之后。

normal.en: Separate the two words and under water means flooded, not undersea.
normal.cn: 分开写 under water 表示被水淹了，而不是在海底。

normal.en: Being underwater on a mortgage means owing more than the house is worth.
normal.cn: underwater on a mortgage 指欠的钱比房子价值还多。

abstract.en: Picture the waterline as a strict border: everything under it lives by different rules of light, sound and weight.
abstract.cn: 把水线想象成一条严格的边界：线以下的一切按另一套光、声与重量的规则生活。

abstract.en: The same word covers a camera, a reef and a debt, because all three have sunk below a line other people set.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既指相机、礁石也指债务，因为三者都沉到了别人划出的某条线以下。

abstract.en: Underwater is not simply wet: it is a whole layer of the world with its own name.
abstract.cn: underwater 不只是「湿」：它是世界的一整个层次，有自己的名字。

examples.en: The underwater cave is home to blind fish and pale shrimp.
examples.cn: 这个水下洞穴里住着盲鱼和苍白的虾。

examples.en: He can hold his breath underwater for nearly two minutes.
examples.cn: 他在水下能憋气将近两分钟。

examples.en: Repair crews sent an underwater robot to check the broken pipe.
examples.cn: 维修队派出水下机器人检查破裂的管道。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的渥特」——安潜到渥特河的水面以下：水下的

root: 由古英语 under（在下面）与 wæter（水）两个日耳曼语系本土词构成，字面就是「在水之下」；近代随潜水、海底工程与水下摄影而广泛使用，后来又借到金融里指资不抵债。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of underwater all keep one relation: something lies below the surface of water, whether it is a place, a tool, a movement, a hidden part, or a debt.
sensesIntro.cn: underwater 的五个义项都维持同一种关系：某物位于水面以下，无论那是地点、器材、动作、隐藏的部分还是债务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a diver sinks through the bright surface into a green, quiet world below.
core.cn: 核心意象：潜水者穿过明亮的水面，沉入下方青绿而安静的世界。

branches.en: THE PLACE: whatever is under the surface is described by one word.
branches.cn: 地点线：凡是水面以下的事物都用这一个词描述。

branches.en: THE GEAR: cameras, lights and robots are named by where they must work.
branches.cn: 器材线：相机、灯与机器人都以必须工作的地方命名。

branches.en: THE MOTION: swimming beneath the surface uses the word as an adverb.
branches.cn: 动作线：在水面以下游泳时，这个词作副词用。

branches.en: THE HIDDEN HALF: a hull or a pier has an underwater part no one sees.
branches.cn: 隐藏线：船体或桥墩都有没人看得见的水下部分。

branches.en: THE DEBT: finance borrows the image for owing more than the value line.
branches.cn: 债务线：金融借用这个意象，指欠款超过价值线。

intro.en: Both halves of underwater are native English words, so the word has no Latin core at all.
intro.cn: underwater 的两半都是英语本土词，因此这个词完全没有拉丁词根核心。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element here; the table below lists only the later Latin-based synonyms that name the same place.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁成分；下表只列出后世以拉丁语为源、指同一位置的近义词。

items.example: The prefix fixes the position below the surface.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀锁定水面以下的位置。

items.meaning: the liquid of seas and rivers
items.example: The noun names the medium that covers the thing.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指覆盖该物的介质。

items.example: It appears in submerged and submarine.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 submerged 与 submarine 中。

items.example: It stresses being drowned rather than being below.
items.exampleCN: 它强调被水盖住而非位置在下面。

items.example: It uses sub plus marinus, of the sea.
items.exampleCN: 它由 sub 加表示「海的」marinus 构成。
underwater 的一个范围更窄的近亲。

items.example: The word is fully native in both halves.
items.exampleCN: 这个词的两半都是完全的英语本土成分。

items.meaning: the line where water touches a hull
items.example: The border that underwater refers to.
items.exampleCN: 正是 underwater 所指的那条界线。

definition_en: to decide in a court that someone is guilty, or a person kept in prison for a crime
core_image: 法槌落下，一句判决把被告从席位上推向牢门
scene: 证据摆满桌面，陪审团低声商议后给出了结论。 The jury voted to convict him of theft.
sceneCN: 这里 convict 指「判定有罪」（第 1 个义项：法庭认定某人有罪）；句意是陪审团投票认定他犯有盗窃罪。

senses.title: To find guilty
senses.definition: to decide officially in a court that someone has committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 由法庭正式认定某人犯有某项罪行
senses.example: The court convicted him of fraud.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭判定他犯有诈骗罪。
senses.why: A court does not say maybe; it says guilty, and the door closes.
senses.whyCN: 法庭不说也许，只说有罪，然后门就关上了。

senses.title: A person in prison
senses.definition: someone who has been found guilty and is serving a sentence
senses.definitionCN: 已被判定有罪并在服刑的人
senses.example: The convict worked in the prison kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 这名囚犯在监狱厨房里干活。
senses.why: A verdict spoken once becomes a name worn for years.
senses.whyCN: 一次宣判说出口，就变成一个要穿很多年的名字。

intro.en: Convict comes from Latin convictus, the past participle of convincere, to prove wrong, built from com-, together, and vincere, to conquer.
intro.cn: convict 来自拉丁语 convictus，是 convincere（证明有错）的过去分词，由 com-（一起）与 vincere（征服）构成。

items.en: Vincere meant to conquer or overcome an opponent.
items.cn: vincere 意为征服或战胜对手。

items.en: Convincere meant to overcome someone with proof.
items.cn: convincere 意为用证据把对方驳倒。

items.en: Convictus described a person overcome by the evidence.
items.cn: convictus 形容被证据压倒的人。

items.en: English convict first meant to prove a person guilty.
items.cn: 英语 convict 最初指证明某人有罪。

items.en: The noun convict named a prisoner sent to a penal colony.
items.cn: 名词 convict 指被送往流放地的囚犯。

items.en: The verb now belongs to courtrooms and the noun to prisons.
items.cn: 今天动词属于法庭，名词属于监狱。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin conquering base vict-, and the meaning group names other words for blame and for prisoners.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的征服词基 vict-，近义组列出其他表示判罪与囚犯的词。

entries.definition: a court decision that someone is guilty
to make someone believe something
to force someone out of a place
to say officially that someone is guilty
a person kept in prison
a person who has broken the law

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with proof that beats a denial, then move to the verdict and to the man it names.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从压倒辩解的证据开始，再到那声判决，最后到判决所命名的人。

normal.en: Con- is together and vict is to conquer, so convict is to conquer someone with proof.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，vict 是征服，convict 就是用证据把人征服。

normal.en: The same letters name the act and the man: first you convict, then he is a convict.
normal.cn: 同一串字母既指动作也指人：先判定有罪，然后他就成了罪犯。

normal.en: Stress moves like the gavel: con-VICT the act, CON-vict the man.
normal.cn: 重音像法槌一样落下：动作读 con-VICT，指人读 CON-vict。

normal.en: Convict and convince share a base, but proof, not persuasion, puts a person in prison.
normal.cn: convict 与 convince 同根，但把人送进监狱的是证据，不是劝说。

normal.en: A verdict is a sentence that turns a listener into a prisoner.
normal.cn: 一句判决，就是一句把听者变成囚犯的话。

abstract.en: Picture a heavy stamp coming down on a sheet of paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚沉重的印章压在一张纸上。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom door closing slowly behind one person.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭的门在一个人身后慢慢关上。

abstract.en: Picture a chain of proof pulling tight around a claim.
abstract.cn: 想象一条证据链在一个说法周围收紧。

examples.en: The jury took three hours to convict her.
examples.cn: 陪审团用了三个小时才判定她有罪。

examples.en: He was convicted of stealing a car.
examples.cn: 他被判犯有偷车罪。

examples.en: The convict had spent ten years inside.
examples.cn: 那名囚犯已经在狱中待了十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 convict 记成 con（完全）加 vict（征服）：证据完全把人征服，就是判定有罪。

root: 源自拉丁语 convincere（用证据驳倒），由 com-（一起、完全）与 vincere（征服）构成，本指以证据压倒对方，后指法庭定罪。

sensesIntro.en: From proof that overcomes a denial, to the verdict it produces, and at last to the person that verdict names.
sensesIntro.cn: 从压过辩解的证据，到由此产生的判决，最后到判决所命名的那个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gavel falling and a prison door closing.
core.cn: 核心意象：法槌落下，牢门关上。

branches.en: Proof conquers doubt and the court says guilty.
branches.cn: 证据战胜怀疑，法庭宣布有罪。

branches.en: The verdict becomes a label worn by a living person.
branches.cn: 判决变成一个活人身上背着的标签。

branches.en: One word holds both the ruling and the ruled-against.
branches.cn: 一个词同时装着裁决和被裁决的人。

branches.en: The verb needs a court, a charge and a conclusion.
branches.cn: 这个动词需要法庭、指控与结论。

branches.en: The noun needs only a person and a closed door.
branches.cn: 这个名词只需要一个人和一扇关上的门。

intro.en: Convict is built on Latin com-, together or completely, plus vincere, to conquer.
intro.cn: convict 由拉丁语 com-（一起、完全）与 vincere（征服）构成。

latinIntro.en: The conquering base vict- or vinc- also runs through convince, victory and invincible.
latinIntro.cn: 征服词基 vict- 或 vinc- 也贯穿 convince、victory 与 invincible。

items.meaning: the state of being proven guilty
items.exampleCN: 这项定罪后来被撤销了。

items.meaning: to win someone over by argument
to turn a person out of a place
items.exampleCN: 他们在冬天被赶了出去。

items.example: The victory came at a cost.

items.exampleCN: 没有哪支队伍是不可战胜的。

definition_zh: 磨坊；面粉厂；工厂；研磨机；磨碎；（人群）乱转
definition_en: a building or machine that grinds grain into flour; a factory where a material or product is made by machinery; a small device for grinding food; and as a verb, to grind something, or of a crowd, to move about with no clear aim
core_image: 河边的老磨坊，木轮被水推着转，石磨里流出细细的面粉
scene: 河水推着木轮慢慢转动，磨坊的窗纸上落了一层白粉，石槽里流出细细的面粉。 The old mill has ground wheat for the village since before anyone can remember.
sceneCN: 这里是「磨坊」（第 1 个义项：磨面的作坊）；句意为这座老磨坊为村子磨麦子，久到没人记得是从何时开始。图中可辨识物件：木水轮、窗纸上的白粉、石磨槽。

derivatives.zh: 由 mill 加 -er 构成，义为「磨坊主；磨坊工人」
由 mill 加 -ing 构成，义为「研磨；碾磨」
由 mill 与 stone 复合而成，义为「磨石；沉重负担」

senses.title: A building where grain is ground into flour
senses.definition: a building fitted with machinery that grinds grain into flour
senses.definitionCN: 装有把谷物磨成面粉的机械的建筑
senses.example: The old mill has ground wheat for the village since before anyone can remember.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老磨坊为村子磨麦子，久到没人记得是从何时开始。
senses.why: The Latin source named a millstone, so the first sense is the place built around the stone that grinds.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源指的是磨石，所以第一层含义就是围绕那块磨石建起来的地方。

senses.title: A factory fitted with machinery
senses.definition: a factory in which a particular material or product is made by machinery, such as steel or paper
senses.definitionCN: 用机械制造某种材料或产品的工厂，如钢厂或造纸厂
senses.example: The steel mill kept three shifts running through the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 这家钢厂整个冬天三班不停。
senses.why: Once a mill is a building full of turning machinery, the word widens from grinding grain to making any product on a large scale.
senses.whyCN: 既然磨坊是一座装满转动机械的建筑，这个词就从磨谷子扩展到大规模制造任何产品。

senses.title: A small machine for grinding
senses.definition: a small device with blades or stones that grinds a food or material inside it
senses.definitionCN: 内置刀片或石磨、用来磨碎食物或材料的小器具
senses.example: She gave the pepper mill three quick turns over the pan.
senses.exampleCN: 她在锅上把胡椒研磨器快速转了三下。
senses.why: The stone that does the grinding can be shrunk into a hand tool, and the tool inherits the name of the whole building.
senses.whyCN: 负责研磨的那块石头可以缩小成一件手持工具，而工具继承了整座建筑的名字。

senses.title: To grind something into powder or a soft mass
senses.definition: to break a solid substance into powder or a smooth mass by crushing it between hard surfaces
senses.definitionCN: 把固体在硬面之间压碎，使其变成粉末或柔滑的团块
senses.example: The workers mill the grain between two heavy stones.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们用两块重石把谷物磨碎。
senses.why: The verb simply puts the building's action into a word: to mill is to do what the mill does to grain.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把磨坊的动作写成一个词：to mill 就是做磨坊对谷物所做的事。

senses.title: Of a crowd, to move about without a clear aim
senses.definition: of a group of people or animals, to move around in a confused, purposeless way
senses.definitionCN: 指一群人或动物毫无目的地、混乱地来回走动
senses.example: Fans milled around the gate long after the concert ended.
senses.exampleCN: 演唱会散场很久了，歌迷们还在大门附近打转。
senses.why: The turning of the mill wheel supplies the picture: people circling with no direction look like something being turned round and round.
senses.whyCN: 磨坊水轮的转动提供了这个画面：没有方向地绕圈的人，看上去就像被转来转去的东西。

intro.en: Mill comes from Late Latin molina, a word for a mill built on Latin mola, a millstone, and molere, to grind; English took the word through Germanic channels.
intro.cn: mill 来自晚期拉丁语 molina（磨坊），其基础是拉丁语 mola（磨石）与 molere（磨），再经日耳曼语转借进入英语。

items.en: Mola meant a millstone, the hard stone on which grain was rubbed or crushed.
items.cn: mola 意为磨石，即用来摩擦、压碎谷物的硬石。

items.en: Molere was the verb to grind, and it stands behind the whole family of milling words.
items.cn: molere 是动词「磨」，整套与研磨有关的词都由它而来。

items.en: Late Latin molina named a mill, was derived from mola, and was passed on to the Germanic languages.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语的 molina 指磨坊，由 mola 派生而来，并传给了日耳曼诸语。

items.en: Old English borrowed the word as mylen or myl, meaning a mill for grinding grain.
items.cn: 古英语借入这个词，写作 mylen 或 myl，指磨谷子的磨坊。

items.en: Modern English shortened the form to mill and widened it from grain to factories, small grinders and the aimless circling of a crowd.
items.cn: 现代英语把它缩短为 mill，并从谷物扩展到工厂、小型研磨器，以及人群无功的打转。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the mill family and one word that only shares its shape; the near-meaning group collects words for factories and for grinding.
note.cn: 形近组收 mill 的词族，外加一个只在字形上相近的词；近义组收表示工厂与研磨的词。

entries.definition: A person who owns or works in a mill, from mill plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 经营或在磨坊工作的人，由 mill 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The act or process of grinding something in a mill.
entries.definitionCN: 在磨坊中研磨某物的动作或过程。

entries.definition: One of the heavy stones used for grinding grain; also used of a burden.
entries.definitionCN: 用于磨谷的重石之一；也比喻沉重负担。

entries.definition: Only the spelling and the vowel pattern are close; this word means a unit of distance, and its origin is different.
entries.definitionCN: 只是拼写与元音组合相近；这个词指距离单位，词源不同。

entries.definition: A building where goods are made in large quantities by machines.
entries.definitionCN: 用机器大批量制造商品的场所。

entries.definition: An industrial site with buildings and machinery for manufacturing.
entries.definitionCN: 带有厂房与机械的工业生产场所。

entries.definition: To crush something into small pieces or powder between hard surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 在硬面之间把东西压碎成小块或粉末。

entries.definition: A room or building where making or repairing is done, usually on a small scale.
entries.definitionCN: 制作或修理的房间或建筑，通常规模较小。

normalIntro.en: The word rests on a Latin millstone and its verb for grinding; the family keeps returning to the stone, the building around it, the factories it grew into and the wheel that turns.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在拉丁语的磨石与「磨」这一动词上；同族词反复回到石头、围绕石头建起的建筑、由它长成的工厂，以及转动的轮子。

normal.en: Mola in Latin meant a millstone, so a mill is first of all a place built around a stone that grinds.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 mola 意为磨石，所以 mill 首先是一个围绕磨石建起来的地方。

normal.en: Molere was to grind, and it links mill to a whole family of words about crushing and powder.
normal.cn: molere 意为磨，它把 mill 与一整族关于压碎与粉末的词连在一起。

normal.en: Mylen was the Old English borrowing, and the modern form cut it down to the single syllable mill.
normal.cn: mylen 是古英语借入的形式，现代形式把它缩成单音节的 mill。

normal.en: Miller adds -er and names the person who runs the mill, while milling names the work itself.
normal.cn: miller 加 -er 指经营磨坊的人，milling 则指这项工作本身。

normal.en: Mill around borrows the turning wheel: a crowd with no aim circles like something being ground.
normal.cn: mill around 借用了转动的轮子：没有目标的人群像被研磨的东西一样打转。

abstract.en: A word that means both a flour mill and a steel mill shows how one machine picture can cover every industry that turns raw material into something else.
abstract.cn: 一个既指面粉磨坊又指钢厂的词说明：同一幅机器画面能覆盖所有把原料变成别物的行业。

abstract.en: Mill around makes people into grain, moving in circles because nobody has set a direction.
abstract.cn: mill around 把人变成谷物，因为没有谁定下方向，只能绕圈。

abstract.en: Grinding is slow, heavy and repeated, which may be why the word also carries the sense of a long, hard process.
abstract.cn: 研磨缓慢、沉重而反复，这或许就是这个词也带着「漫长艰苦过程」意味的原因。

examples.en: The old mill has ground wheat for the village since before anyone can remember.
examples.cn: 这座老磨坊为村子磨麦子，久到没人记得是从何时开始。

examples.en: The steel mill kept three shifts running through the winter.
examples.cn: 这家钢厂整个冬天三班不停。

examples.en: Fans milled around the gate long after the concert ended.
examples.cn: 演唱会散场很久了，歌迷们还在大门附近打转。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「米了」——稻米进了磨坊，出来就成了米粉；记住 mill 是磨坊、磨碎。

root: 拉丁语 mola（磨石）与 molere（磨）组成晚期拉丁语 molina（磨坊），经日耳曼语转借为古英语 mylen，后缩为 mill；同族词多与研磨、工厂有关。

sensesIntro.en: The core is a stone that grinds; the senses spread from the mill building to the factory, the small grinder, the act of grinding and the aimless circling of a crowd.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是一块负责研磨的石头；义项从磨坊建筑扩到工厂、小型研磨器、磨碎的动作，以及人群无功的打转。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old mill by a river, its wooden wheel turned by water, fine flour flowing out of the stone channel.
core.cn: 核心意象：河边的老磨坊，木轮被水推着转，石磨里流出细细的面粉。

branches.en: a water wheel turning beside a stone wall
branches.cn: 水边转动的木轮与石墙

branches.en: a long shed roofed in steel beside a rail line
branches.cn: 铁轨旁一排钢顶厂房

branches.en: a small grinder on a kitchen table
branches.cn: 厨房桌上的一只小研磨器

branches.en: flour falling in a slow white line
branches.cn: 缓缓落下的一线白面粉

branches.en: a crowd circling a locked gate
branches.cn: 在锁着的大门前打转的人群

intro.en: The word is carried by the Latin noun for a millstone, the verb to grind, the Late Latin name for a mill, the Old English borrowing and two English endings.
intro.cn: 这个词由拉丁语的磨石名词、表示「磨」的动词、晚期拉丁语的磨坊名、古英语借词，以及两个英语词尾共同支撑。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

definition_zh: 胜利；成功；得意；凯旋；战胜
definition_en: a great victory or success, or the joy felt after winning
core_image: 胜利者站在高处，人群沿街欢呼，花环从车窗上垂下来
scene: 最后一球落地，全场观众站起来，球员把球衣举过头顶。 The team’s triumph in the final was greeted with fireworks.
sceneCN: 这里 triumph 是「胜利」（第 1 个义项：一场重大的胜利）；句意为球队在决赛中的胜利在烟火中受到欢庆。球场沸腾的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「凯旋的；庆祝胜利的」
名词加 -ant 构成形容词，义为「获胜的；得意洋洋的」
形容词加 -ly 构成副词，义为「得意地；胜利地」

senses.title: A great victory
senses.definition: a very great victory or a notable success after a struggle
senses.definitionCN: 经过斗争取得的重大胜利或显著成功
senses.example: The climb was a triumph over fear.
senses.exampleCN: 这次攀登是对恐惧的一次胜利。
senses.why: The Latin triumphus names the procession of a victorious general into Rome.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 triumphus 指得胜将军列队进入罗马的凯旋式。

senses.title: The joy of winning
senses.definition: the strong feeling of joy and pride that follows a victory
senses.definitionCN: 胜利之后强烈的喜悦与自豪
senses.example: She could not hide her triumph when the results came.
senses.exampleCN: 结果出来时，她掩不住得意。
senses.why: The procession was a public show of joy, and the word keeps that feeling.
senses.whyCN: 凯旋式本就是把喜悦公开出来，这个词把那份情绪也保留下来。

senses.title: To win or overcome
senses.definition: to gain a victory over an opponent, a difficulty, or a weakness
senses.definitionCN: 战胜对手、困难或弱点
senses.example: Good sense triumphed over panic.
senses.exampleCN: 理智战胜了恐慌。
senses.why: The verb turns the procession into an act: to be the one led home in honour.
senses.whyCN: 动词把凯旋式变成一个动作：成为被光荣迎回的那个人。

senses.title: An outstanding achievement
senses.definition: a work or result that stands far above others
senses.definitionCN: 远超同类的作品或成果
senses.example: The bridge is a triumph of engineering.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥是工程的杰作。
senses.why: Any great finished work can be met with the applause once given to a returning general.
senses.whyCN: 任何完成的伟大作品，都能得到当年献给凯旋将军的那份掌声。

intro.en: The word comes from Latin triumphus, the honour paid to a victorious general entering Rome.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 triumphus，是给得胜将军进入罗马时所受的荣典。

items.en: Triumphus names the ceremonial entry of a victorious commander into the city of Rome.
items.cn: 拉丁语 triumphus 指得胜统帅列队进入罗马城的仪式。

items.en: The word is probably borrowed into Latin from Greek thriambos, a hymn to Dionysus sung in procession.
items.cn: 这个词大概是从希腊语 thriambos 借入拉丁语的，那是列队所唱的狄俄尼索斯颂歌。

items.en: Old French triumphe passes the word into English with its victory sense.
items.cn: 古法语 triumphe 把这个词连同胜利义传入英语。

items.en: English uses the noun first of the Roman ceremony, then of any great victory.
items.cn: 英语先用这个名词指罗马的仪式，后指任何重大胜利。

items.en: The senses widen to the feeling of victory and to any outstanding achievement.
items.cn: 后来又扩及胜利的感受与任何卓越成就。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin triumph- stem, while the near-meaning group gathers other words for winning.
note.cn: 形近组共用拉丁语 triumph- 词干，近义组汇集其他表示取胜的词。

entries.definition: celebrating a victory
having won or showing joy at winning
a brass wind instrument
entries.definitionCN: 小号；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a card that beats the others
entries.definitionCN: 王牌；只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the act of winning a battle or contest
the achieving of a goal
great honour and praise
the losing of a battle or contest

normalIntro.en: Hear the trumpet in triumph, and see the arch in the street.
normalIntro.cn: 在 triumph 里听出 trumpet 的号声，再看街道上的凯旋门。

normal.en: A triumphal arch is built to honour a return.
normal.cn: 凯旋门是为纪念归来的胜利者而建。

normal.en: Triumphal is the adjective of the ceremony, triumphant of the winner.
normal.cn: triumphal 形容仪式，triumphant 形容得胜者。

normal.en: Triumph over is the usual phrase for beating a difficulty.
normal.cn: triumph over 是战胜困难的常用搭配。

normal.en: The Romans borrowed the word from a Greek song in procession.
normal.cn: 罗马人是从希腊列队所唱的颂歌里借来这个词的。

normal.en: A bridge or a painting can be called a triumph too.
normal.cn: 一座桥或一幅画也可以称得上杰作。

abstract.en: Picture a general in a chariot with the crowd shouting.
abstract.cn: 想象将军站在战车上，人群呼喊。

abstract.en: See flower wreaths hanging from the carriage rails.
abstract.cn: 看花环从车栏上垂下来。

abstract.en: Hear the horns and keep that noise for the word.
abstract.cn: 听号角声，把这份热闹留给这个词。

examples.en: The victory parade marked the triumph of the long campaign.
examples.cn: 胜利游行标志着这场长期战役的凯旋。

examples.en: She triumphed over her fear of water at forty.
examples.cn: 她四十岁时战胜了对水的恐惧。

examples.en: The new library is a triumph of quiet design.
examples.cn: 新图书馆是静默设计的杰作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「揣安姆」——揣着奖杯放心安下来，姆指一竖就是胜利。

root: 拉丁语 triumphus（凯旋式），可能借自希腊语 thriambos（列队唱的酒神颂），经古法语进入英语；同族有 triumphal、triumphant

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the Roman procession to a private feeling and to any finished masterpiece.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从罗马的凯旋式，一路走到个人的感受与任何完成后的杰作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a victor riding through a shouting city.
core.cn: 核心意象：胜利者穿过欢呼的城。

branches.en: The victory sense, the plain fact of winning.
branches.cn: 胜利义：取胜这一事实本身。

branches.en: The feeling sense, where the celebration goes inward.
branches.cn: 情绪义：欢庆转到了心里。

branches.en: The verb sense, where a person overcomes something.
branches.cn: 动词义：人克服了某物。

branches.en: The achievement sense, where a work earns the ovation.
branches.cn: 成就义：一件作品赢得了欢呼。

branches.en: The victory sense again, where the parade begins.
branches.cn: 再回胜利义：游行的起点。

intro.en: The word came whole from Latin, and its endings were already in place.
intro.cn: 这个词是从拉丁语整体借来的，词尾早就带在身上。

latinIntro.en: Triumphus has no common Latin verb behind it in English use, so the Latin list gives only the noun.
latinIntro.cn: triumphus 在英语用法里没有常见拉丁动词相配，因此拉丁同源词只列名词。

items.example: In triumph the -ant marks the feeling, not the person.
items.exampleCN: 在 triumph 里，-ant 标记的是情绪而非人。

items.meaning: the written ph stands for the f sound
items.meaningCN: ph 写法表示 f 音
items.example: Triumph ends in ph, as in triumph and nymph.
items.exampleCN: triumph 以 ph 收尾，如同 nymph。

items.example: The arch stands at the road’s end.

items.meaningCN: 王牌；与 triumph 只是拼写相近
items.example: Trump looks like triumph but is another word.
items.exampleCN: trump 看着像 triumph，却是另一个词。

definition_en: a thick, dark liquid found underground, made of hydrocarbons and refined into fuels, plastics and chemicals
core_image: 荒原上的抽油机把地层深处的黑色液体一点点提上来
scene: 荒原上，抽油机一下一下地点头，黑色液体顺着管道流向储罐。 The refinery turns petroleum into fuel, plastic and medicine.
sceneCN: 这里是「原油」（第 2 个义项：尚未提炼的天然烃类液体）；句意为炼油厂把石油变成燃料、塑料和药品。图中可辨识物件：抽油机、输油管、储罐。

derivatives.zh: 由 petroleum 的短语 petroleum spirit 截短而来，英式指炼出的车用汽油
由 petro-（岩石、石油）与 chemical 复合，指石油化工产品
由 petro- 与表示「含有」的 -ferous 构成，义为「含石油的」

senses.title: The hydrocarbon resource as a whole
senses.definition: the family of liquid hydrocarbons found underground and used as a raw material for fuel, plastic and chemicals
senses.definitionCN: 在地下生成的一类液态碳氢化合物，用作燃料、塑料和化工的原料
senses.example: The country's economy depends on petroleum.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家的经济依赖石油。
senses.why: Because the same substance is pumped, shipped, refined and sold at many separate stages, English uses one mass noun for the whole chain, and petroleum covers the resource rather than any single product.
senses.whyCN: 同一种物质要经过开采、运输、炼制、销售许多环节，英语便用一个不可数名词统称整条链；petroleum 因此指的是这种资源本身，而不是某一件成品。

senses.title: Crude oil before refining
senses.definition: the unrefined oil that comes out of a well, a dark sticky liquid that must be processed before use
senses.definitionCN: 从油井中采出、尚未提炼的油，是必须加工后才能使用的深色黏稠液体
senses.example: Tanker trucks carried crude petroleum to the port.
senses.exampleCN: 罐车把原油运往港口。
senses.why: The word's literal anatomy is rock plus oil, naming what seeps out of stone; that image fits the raw liquid at the wellhead, so the sense narrows to unrefined crude.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的字面构造是「岩石」加「油」，命名的是从石头里渗出来的东西；这个画面正对应井口那股未经处理的液体，于是词义收窄为「原油」。

senses.title: Rock oil as an old medicinal substance
senses.definition: the historical name for oily seepages from rock, once sold in shops as a remedy for aches and worms
senses.definitionCN: 历史上对岩石渗出油状物的称呼，曾在店铺里作为治疼痛和驱虫的药物出售
senses.example: Early sellers advertised petroleum as a cure for almost anything.
senses.exampleCN: 早年的卖家把岩石油吹成几乎什么病都能治的药。
senses.why: Medieval Latin coined the word for a mineral seep sold by apothecaries, and that medical past survives whenever histories describe petroleum as a folk remedy.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语造这个词时，指的是药剂师出售的矿物渗出油；只要史书把它写成民间药方，这段医药的旧义就仍然在场。

intro.en: Petroleum is a medieval Latin compound of Greek rock and Latin oil, kept almost unchanged in English while a short French form split off for motor fuel.
intro.cn: petroleum 是中世纪拉丁语用希腊语「岩石」与拉丁语「油」拼成的复合词，英语几乎原样保留，而法语的短形式则分出去专指车用燃料。

items.en: Greek petra meant rock or stone, and it named the hard ground from which the oil oozed.
items.cn: 希腊语 petra 意为岩石、石头，指的正是渗出油来的坚硬地层。

items.en: Latin oleum meant oil, and it could describe both olive oil and mineral oil.
items.cn: 拉丁语 oleum 意为油，既能指橄榄油，也能指矿物油。

items.en: Medieval writers joined the two into petroleum, rock oil, for the bituminous seeps sold as medicine.
items.cn: 中世纪作者把两者拼成 petroleum，即「岩石油」，用来指当作药物出售的沥青状渗出物。

items.en: French shortened the Latin word to pétrole and used it for refined lamp and machine oils.
items.cn: 法语把拉丁词缩短为 pétrole，用来指提炼后的灯油和机油。

items.en: English kept the full Latin form for the underground resource and its industry, while the short French form became petrol for motor fuel.
items.cn: 英语保留完整的拉丁形式，指地下的资源及其工业；法语的短形式则变成 petrol，专指车用燃料。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same rock-and-oil stem; the near-meaning group gathers other underground or liquid energy substances.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「岩石加油」词干上的词；近义组收其他地下或液态的能源物质。

entries.definition: The British word for the light fuel refined from petroleum.
entries.definitionCN: 英式英语中由石油炼出的轻质燃料。

entries.definition: A chemical product made from petroleum or natural gas.
entries.definitionCN: 由石油或天然气制成的化学品。

entries.definition: Containing petroleum, said of rock formations.
entries.definitionCN: 含石油的，用于形容岩层。

entries.definition: The study of rocks, from the same Greek word for stone.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石的学科，来自同一个表示石头的希腊词。

entries.definition: Oil in its raw state, before refining.
A general word for greasy liquids from plant, animal or mineral sources.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指油脂类液体的词，可来自植物、动物或矿物。

entries.definition: A rock layer that can yield oil or gas when heated.
entries.definitionCN: 加热后能产出油或气的岩层。

entries.definition: The gaseous fuel often found and extracted alongside petroleum.
entries.definitionCN: 常与石油一起被发现和开采的气态燃料。

normalIntro.en: The word is a transparent compound of rock and oil, and its family shows how a resource, a fuel and a chemical industry all branch from it.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「岩石」与「油」的透明复合，其同族词显示资源、燃料与化工产业如何从它分出去。

normal.en: Petroleum is literally rock oil: petra is rock and oleum is oil.
normal.cn: petroleum 字面就是「岩石之油」：petra 是岩石，oleum 是油。

normal.en: The word keeps its full Latin shape because industry needed a formal name for the resource, not for a product on a forecourt.
normal.cn: 这个词保留完整的拉丁形态，因为工业需要的是给资源而非给加油站商品的正式名称。

normal.en: Petrol is the clipped descendant used in Britain for the refined fuel, so the short word is the product and the long word is the source.
normal.cn: petrol 是截短后的后代词，英式用来指炼好的燃料；短词是产品，长词是来源。

normal.en: Petroleum jelly and petroleum coke show how the word becomes a label in front of things derived from the crude.
normal.cn: petroleum jelly 与 petroleum coke 表明这个词会像标签一样，用在原油衍生品的名称前。

normal.en: Crude petroleum is a fixed phrase because petroleum alone can already mean the whole resource.
normal.cn: crude petroleum 是固定说法，因为 petroleum 本身已经可以指整个资源范畴。

abstract.en: Sunlight fell on a swamp, plankton died, and pressure turned that layer into the black liquid now called petroleum.
abstract.cn: 阳光照进沼泽，浮游生物死去，压力把那一层变成了如今被称作石油的黑色液体。

abstract.en: A word meaning rock oil reminds you that this fuel is first of all a product of geology, cooked in stone over millions of years.
abstract.cn: 一个意为「岩石油」的词提醒人：这种燃料首先是地质的产物，在石头里熬了数百万年。

abstract.en: The long word sounds official because it names the resource; the short one sounds ordinary because it names what you buy.
abstract.cn: 长词听起来正式，因为它命名资源；短词听起来日常，因为它命名你买到手的东西。

examples.en: The country's economy depends on petroleum.
examples.cn: 这个国家的经济依赖石油。

examples.en: Tanker trucks carried crude petroleum to the port.
examples.cn: 罐车把原油运往港口。

examples.en: Petroleum is refined into petrol, plastics and fertiliser.
examples.cn: 石油被炼制成汽油、塑料和化肥。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「劈石流油」——钻头劈开岩层，黑油汩汩流出；petroleum 是石油。

root: 希腊语 petra（岩石）加拉丁语 oleum（油），构成中世纪拉丁语 petroleum（岩石油），经法语 pétrole 进入英语；短形式 petrol 专指炼出的车用燃料。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is the underground hydrocarbon resource; it divides into unrefined crude at the wellhead and a historical medicinal sense of rock oil.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是地下的烃类资源；由此分出井口那股未提炼的原油，以及历史上把岩石油当药的旧义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pumpjack lifting black liquid out of deep stone.
core.cn: 核心意象：抽油机把黑色液体从深层岩层中提上来。

branches.en: a pumpjack nodding over a dry plain
branches.cn: 抽油机在干旱的荒原上不停点头

branches.en: a pipeline carrying crude toward the coast
branches.cn: 输油管把原油送往海边

branches.en: a tanker crossing the sea with a full hold
branches.cn: 满载的油轮穿过海面

branches.en: a glass bottle of rock oil on an apothecary's shelf
branches.cn: 药剂师架子上的一瓶岩石油

branches.en: the same liquid, first as resource and then as cargo
branches.cn: 同一种液体，先是资源，后是货物

intro.en: The name is a medieval compound of a Greek rock word and a Latin oil word, kept almost unchanged while the short French form split off for motor fuel.
intro.cn: 这个名称是中世纪由希腊语「岩石」与拉丁语「油」组成的复合词，几乎原样保留；法语的短形式则分出去，专指车用燃料。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

items.meaningCN: 构成物质名词的中性词尾

definition_zh: 精确；精密度；精确性；（仪器、测量的）精度；有效数字位数；（加工）公差
definition_en: the quality of being exact, especially the fineness of a measurement or the closeness of repeated readings to one another
core_image: 一把薄刃把多余的部分削掉，只留下真正要的那一点
scene: 实验室的台面上摆着一支滴定管、一本记录册和一台电子天平，同一份样品被反复称了五回。 The precision of the balance showed in five readings that differed by less than a milligram.
sceneCN: 这里 precision 指「统计意义上的重复一致性」（第 2 个义项：重复测量的一致程度）；句意：这台天平的精密度体现在五次读数相差不到一毫克。图中可辨识物件：滴定管、记录册、电子天平、样品瓶；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 精确；精密度；精度；精确性

senses.title: The fineness of a stated measurement
senses.titleCN: 测量值本身的精细程度
senses.definition: the degree to which a stated measurement is divided into fine enough steps for two nearby values to be told apart
senses.definitionCN: 一个测量值被细分到多细的程度，即能否把两个接近的值区分开
senses.example: The precision of the reading was limited by the smallest mark on the ruler.
senses.exampleCN: 这个读数的精度受限于尺子上最小的那道刻度。
senses.why: Praecisio is a cutting off, and a finely stated measurement is one cut into narrow slices.
senses.whyCN: praecisio 本义是切去，精细报出的测量值就是把量切成一薄片一薄片。

senses.title: Repeatability across repeated measurements
senses.definition: in statistics, the closeness of repeated measurements to one another, whether or not they sit near the true value
senses.definitionCN: 统计上多次测量彼此接近的程度，与它们是否靠近真值无关
senses.example: The five runs showed high precision even when the average was slightly off.
senses.exampleCN: 五次运行即使平均值略有偏差，重复精密度依然很高。
senses.why: Statistics separates the scatter among repeats, called precision, from the distance to the truth, called accuracy.
senses.whyCN: 统计学把重复测量的分散程度称为精密度，把与真值的距离称为准确度，两者分开。

senses.title: The smallest step an instrument can show
senses.definition: the smallest change in a quantity that an instrument can register, display or resolve
senses.definitionCN: 仪器能够记录、显示或分辨的最小变化量
senses.example: The instrument's precision reaches one part in a million.
senses.exampleCN: 这台仪器的精度达到百万分之一。
senses.why: An instrument whose scale is cut more finely can separate values that a coarse one merges.
senses.whyCN: 刻度切得更细的仪器，能把粗仪器混在一起的值分开。

senses.title: Exactness in wording
senses.definition: careful exactness in the choice of words, so that a statement admits only one reading
senses.definitionCN: 用词上的细致准确，使一句话只容许一种读法
senses.example: She described the procedure with the precision of a manual.
senses.exampleCN: 她像操作手册一样精确地描述了步骤。
senses.why: Latin praecisio also meant brevity of speech, where every surplus word has been cut away.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 praecisio 也指言辞简省，即把多余的词都切掉。

senses.title: Targeted action on a small site
senses.titleCN: 精准农业与精准医疗的定点干预
senses.definition: an approach that directs water, treatment or medicine only to the exact field, place or patient that needs it
senses.definitionCN: 只把水、处理或药物投到确切需要的田块、地点或病人身上的做法
senses.example: Precision irrigation delivers water to the driest rows alone.
senses.exampleCN: 精准灌溉只把水送到最干的那几垄。
senses.why: The modern compounds keep the old image of a cut made exactly where it is wanted.
senses.whyCN: 现代复合词保留了老意象：只在需要的地方下刀。

senses.title: The number of reliable digits
senses.definition: the count of digits in a reported value that carry real information about how finely it is known
senses.definitionCN: 一个报告值中携带真实精细信息的数字位数
senses.example: Report the mean to four digits of precision.
senses.exampleCN: 把平均值报到四位有效数字。
senses.why: Digits past the reliable cut are noise, so counting the trustworthy digits states the precision.
senses.whyCN: 可靠切点之后的位只是噪声，数出可信位数就是在说明精度。

senses.title: Machining to a very small tolerance
senses.titleCN: 机械加工的公差与精度
senses.definition: the closeness with which a machined part matches its specified size, measured in very small units
senses.definitionCN: 加工件与规定尺寸吻合的紧密程度，以极小的单位计量
senses.example: The shop grinds bearings to a precision of two microns.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂把轴承磨到两微米的精度。
senses.why: In a machine shop the abstract fineness becomes metal cut away until the part fits.
senses.whyCN: 在机加工车间，抽象的精细变成被切掉的金属，直到零件合适。

senses.title: Strict exactness in legal or formal form
senses.titleCN: 法律或形式上的严格精确
senses.definition: the strict following of exact wording or procedure, where no looseness or paraphrase is permitted
senses.definitionCN: 严格遵循确切的措辞或程序，不允许任何松动或改写
senses.example: The clause was drafted with precision to close every loophole.
senses.exampleCN: 这一条款起草得十分精确，堵住了每个漏洞。
senses.why: A legal cut must fall on exactly the right word, which is the original image applied to text.
senses.whyCN: 法律之刀必须落在确切的字上，正是原意象用在文本上。

intro.en: Precision comes from Latin praecisio 'a cutting off', a noun of action from praecidere 'to cut short', built on prae- 'in front' plus caedere 'to cut'. French carried the word into English in the sixteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: precision 出自拉丁 praecisio「切去」，是 praecidere「切短」的动作名词，由 prae-「在前」加 caedere「切」构成。英语十六世纪经法语引入。年代均为约数。

items.en: Caedere meant 'to cut, to strike down'; it also underlies incision, excise and decision, each of which turns on a cut.
items.cn: caedere 意为「切、砍倒」，也构成 incision、excise 与 decision，这几个词都围绕「切」展开。

items.en: Prae- 'in front' plus caedere made praecidere 'to cut off in front, to shorten'; a speech that was praecisus had its surplus trimmed away.
items.cn: prae-「在前」加 caedere 构成 praecidere「切去前面、截短」；被称作 praecisus 的言辞就是把多余部分削掉了。

items.en: Praecisio named the act of cutting off and also brevity of style, so the notion of fine trimming sits inside both senses.
items.cn: praecisio 既指切去的动作，也指文风的简省，因此「削到恰好」的观念同时存在于这两层。

items.en: Middle French precision brought the word into English, first for concise speech and only later for exact measurement.
items.cn: 中古法语 precision 把这个词带进英语，先用于简练的言辞，较晚才用于精确测量。

items.en: Nineteenth-century science and manufacturing applied the word to instrument scales and machined parts, which produced the modern technical senses.
items.cn: 十九世纪的科学与制造业把这个词用到仪器刻度和加工零件上，现代技术义项由此形成。

items.en: First English citation uncertain: the direct source is Latin praecisio, attested in the classical language, so the word itself is not in doubt; only the exact year of its first English use is not recorded. The usual route is through French, while a direct Latin borrowing is also argued; no single route is imposed here.
items.cn: 首见年代不确定：直接来源是有据可查的拉丁语 praecisio，词本身并不存疑；只是英语最早用例的具体年份没有记录。通常认为经法语传入，也有直接借自拉丁语的说法；此处不强行选定单一传入路径。

note.en: Group one is the same Latin family seen through its adjective, adverb and negative forms; group two holds the measuring partners that share the field but answer a different question.
note.cn: 第一组是同一拉丁词族在形容词、副词与否定形式上的样子；第二组是同处测量领域的伙伴词，但它们回答的是另一个问题。

entries.definition: Giving exact details with nothing vague; it describes the thing or the person, while precision names the quality itself.
entries.definitionCN: 给出确切细节、毫不含糊；它形容事物或人，而 precision 是这种性质本身。

entries.definition: In an exact way, or used as an emphatic 'exactly'; it modifies an action rather than naming a measured degree.
entries.definitionCN: 以确切的方式，或用作加强语气的「正是」；它修饰动作，不指一个测得的程度。

entries.definition: Lack of exactness, formed with the negative prefix im-; it is the direct opposite of precision in every sense.
entries.definitionCN: 不精确，由否定前缀 im- 构成；在各义项上都是 precision 的反面。

entries.definition: A less common synonym for precision, stressing the manner of being exact rather than a measured degree of fineness.
entries.definitionCN: precision 的罕用同义词，强调一丝不苟的作风，而非测得的精细程度。

entries.definition: How near a measurement lies to the true value; a rifle can be accurate while its shots are widely spread.
entries.definitionCN: 测量值与真值的接近程度；一支枪可以很准确，但弹着点散布很广。

entries.definition: The state of being wholly correct, often said of a figure or a copy rather than of a spread of repeats.
entries.definitionCN: 完全正确的状态，常用于数字或副本，而不是重复测量的散布。

entries.definition: The smallest interval an instrument or an image can distinguish; it is the hardware side of precision.
entries.definitionCN: 仪器或图像能分辨的最小间隔；它是精密度在硬件上的表现。

entries.definition: The range of variation a specification allows; precision is the aim, tolerance is the slack accepted around it.
entries.definitionCN: 规格允许的变动范围；precision 是瞄准的目标，tolerance 是允许的松量。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses keep one cut: a finely stated value, statistical repeatability, an instrument's smallest step, exact wording, targeted action, reliable digits, machining tolerance and strict legal form.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项守着同一刀：精细报出的测量值、统计上的重复一致性、仪器的最小刻度、确切的措辞、定点干预、可靠位数、加工公差，以及法律形式上的严格精确。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin blade cutting away everything that is not the exact point.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把薄刃削掉一切不属于那一点的部分。

branches.en: FINE DIVISIONS: stating a value in narrow steps and counting the reliable digits are the same cut seen from two sides.
branches.cn: 细分：把值报成窄小的台阶与数出可靠位数，是同一刀的两面。

branches.en: REPEATS AGREE: statistical precision is the spread among repeats, not the distance from the truth.
branches.cn: 重复一致：统计上的精密度是重复测量之间的散布，而不是与真值的距离。

branches.en: THE INSTRUMENT'S EDGE: a finer scale lets a device separate what a coarse one merges.
branches.cn: 仪器的刃口：刻度更细的装置能把粗装置混在一起的值分开。

branches.en: CLEAN WORDING: exact speech and strict legal form both cut off every second reading.
branches.cn: 干净的措辞：确切的表达与严格的法律形式，都切掉了第二种读法。

branches.en: ACTION AT ONE SPOT: precision farming and precision machining both demand the cut land where the work requires.
branches.cn: 定点下手：精准农业与精密加工都要求这一刀落在工作真正需要的地方。

intro.en: Precision is a Latin noun of action built from a prefix, a verb root and a suffix, and the same pieces also build the everyday adjectives precise and imprecise.
intro.cn: precision 是由前缀、动词词根与后缀构成的拉丁动作名词，同样的构件也造出日常形容词 precise 与 imprecise。

latinIntro.en: Prae- 'in front' plus caedere 'to cut' yields praecidere, and -io turns it into the action noun praecisio; English then adds -ly and -ness and negates the whole word with im-.
latinIntro.cn: prae-「在前」加 caedere「切」得到 praecidere，-io 把它变成动作名词 praecisio；英语再加上 -ly 与 -ness，并用 im- 否定整个词。

normal.cn: 重音在第一个音节：AR-row。

abstract.en: See a string released and a shaft flying.
abstract.cn: 想象弓弦松开、箭飞出去。

abstract.en: See a white chevron painted on asphalt.
abstract.cn: 想象沥青上画着的白色箭形。

abstract.en: See a hand pointing firmly at a door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手坚定地指向门口。

examples.en: The arrow struck the outer ring of the target.
examples.cn: 那支箭射中了靶的外圈。

examples.en: A white arrow on the road showed us where to turn.
examples.cn: 路面上一个白色箭头告诉我们该往哪里转。

examples.en: He drew the bow and let the arrow fly.
examples.cn: 他拉满弓，把箭射了出去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 arrow 想成一条笔直的线加一个尖：既是射出的箭，也是指路的箭头。

root: 源自古英语 earh 与古诺斯语 or，中古英语作 arwe，后固定为 arrow；由武器义引申为指示方向的箭头符号。

sensesIntro.en: A straight flight toward a mark became the sign that shows a way.
sensesIntro.cn: 直奔目标的飞行，成了指引方向的符号。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shaft leaving the string and cutting forward.
core.cn: 核心意象：箭离弦向前穿出。

branches.en: bow and arrow
branches.cn: 弓箭

branches.en: shoot an arrow
branches.cn: 射箭

branches.en: follow the arrow
branches.cn: 跟着箭头走

branches.en: an arrow on the map
branches.cn: 地图上的箭头

branches.en: press the arrow key
branches.cn: 按方向键

intro.en: A Germanic weapon word with very few derivatives.
intro.cn: 这是一个日耳曼语系的武器词，派生词很少。

latinIntro.en: The word has no Latin root; its compounds are all English.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，其复合词都由英语自身构成。

definition_zh: 作家；作者；撰写者；写字的人
definition_en: a person who writes books, articles, or other texts, especially as a job
core_image: 窗边一张堆满纸的书桌，有人在上面一遍遍划掉又重写
scene: 午后的书桌上落着一层薄灰，稿纸摞得比水杯还高，键盘上几个字母已磨得发亮。 The writer spent three years on the same novel.
sceneCN: 这里 writer 是「作家；作者」（第 1 个义项：以写书、写文章为业或擅长写作的人）；句意为这位作家在同一部小说上花了三年。窗边堆满纸的书桌与反复涂改的手，就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 由 writer 加 -ly 构成，义为「作家式的；有文人气质的」
由 write 加 -ing 构成的名词，义为「写作；文字；作品」
由 writer 加 -ship 构成，义为「作家身份；写作职业」

senses.title: The maker of books
senses.definition: a person who writes books, stories, or articles, often as a profession
senses.definitionCN: 写书、写故事或写文章的人，常以写作为职业
senses.example: The writer spent three years on the same novel.
senses.exampleCN: 这位作家在同一部小说上花了三年。
senses.why: The suffix -er turns the act of writing into the name of the person who does it, so the worker comes from the work.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -er 把写作这个动作变成做这件事的人，于是人从事情里长出来。

senses.title: The hand behind a text
senses.definition: the particular person who produced a given letter, report, or message
senses.definitionCN: 某一封信、报告或消息的具体写作者
senses.example: The writer of the letter never gave a name.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信的写信人始终没有留下姓名。
senses.why: Any text has an author behind it, so the word also fixes the single hand that made this one.
senses.whyCN: 任何文本背后都有作者，于是这个词也用来确定造就这一篇的那只手。

senses.title: The one who forms letters
senses.definition: someone who is writing or who writes in a particular way, without being an author
senses.definitionCN: 正在写字或以某种方式写字的人，不一定是作者
senses.example: Left-handed writers often turn the page slightly.
senses.exampleCN: 惯用左手写字的人常把纸斜一点。
senses.why: The plain action sense survives beside the professional one, because a person can write without writing books.
senses.whyCN: 不带职业色彩的动作义与职业义并存，因为一个人可以只写字而不写书。

senses.title: Something that writes
senses.definition: a thing that performs the action of writing, as in phrases about a good or bad writer of a pen
senses.definitionCN: 执行书写动作的物品，如说一支笔写得好或不好
senses.example: This old pen is a slow writer and leaves ink spots.
senses.exampleCN: 这支旧笔写起来很慢，还会漏墨点。
senses.why: Since -er can also mark a tool, an instrument may be called a writer by the action it performs.
senses.whyCN: 因为 -er 也可以指工具，所以器具可以按它做的事被叫作 writer。

intro.en: Writer is the English agent noun of write, built in the Middle English period with the ending -er that marks the doer.
intro.cn: writer 是 write 在英语内部构成的施动名词，中古英语时期加上表示「做某事的人」的 -er。

items.en: The verb writan already had related agent forms in use for scribes.
items.cn: 动词 writan 当时已有指抄写者的相关施动形式。

items.en: writere named anyone who writes, from a clerk to the author of a book.
items.cn: writere 指任何写字的人，从书记到书的作者。

items.en: Printing made books cheap and turned writer into a clear profession.
items.cn: 印刷让书变便宜，writer 也成了明确的职业名称。

items.en: Compounds such as songwriter and ghost writer spread the agent noun widely.
items.cn: songwriter、ghost writer 这样的复合词把这个施动名词推向各处。

items.en: Today the word covers novelists, journalists, and anyone who composes a text.
items.cn: 今天这个词覆盖小说家、记者以及任何写成一篇文章的人。

note.en: The first group gathers the write family, the second gathers words for those who produce texts.
note.cn: 第一组集合 write 的词族，第二组集合其他指写文章的人的词。

entries.definition: More than one writer.
To put words down in marks.
The act of writing or the text produced.
The person who wrote a book or started a plan.
A person who writes novels.
A person who writes news and reports.

normalIntro.en: Writer is simply write plus -er, so the spelling of write is kept whole before the ending.
normalIntro.cn: writer 就是 write 加 -er，因此词尾之前完整保留了 write 的拼写。

normal.en: Drop nothing when adding -er: write becomes writer.
normal.cn: 加 -er 时不用丢字母：write 就是 writer。

normal.en: The w stays silent, so the first syllable sounds like rye.
normal.cn: w 仍不发音，第一个音节读起来像 rye。

normal.en: A songwriter writes songs, and a ghost writer writes for someone else.
normal.cn: songwriter 写歌，ghost writer 替别人写。

normal.en: The -er ending marks the person who does the action.
normal.cn: 后缀 -er 标示做这个动作的人。

normal.en: Author is the Latin cousin used more in publishing.
normal.cn: author 是拉丁语系的近亲，在出版界更常用。

abstract.en: A desk covered with crossed-out pages.
abstract.cn: 一张铺满划掉稿纸的桌子。

abstract.en: One lamp still on after everyone else has gone to bed.
abstract.cn: 别人都睡下后仍亮着的一盏灯。

abstract.en: A voice that exists only on the page.
abstract.cn: 只存在于纸面上的一个声音。

examples.en: She became a writer after ten years as a teacher.
examples.cn: 当了十年老师后，她成了作家。

examples.en: The writer of the report asked for more time.
examples.cn: 这份报告的撰写人要求多给些时间。

examples.en: Writers often read their own sentences aloud to test them.
examples.cn: 写作者常把自己的句子读出声来检验。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞特」——稿纸堆成塔，瑞特是那个一直写到手酸的人。

root: 由动词 write（古英语 writan，刻划、书写）加施动后缀 -er 构成，字面义为「写字的人」，后专指以写作为业的人。

sensesIntro.en: The profession comes first, then the particular hand behind one text, then anyone forming letters, then even a pen doing the writing.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是职业，再是某篇文字背后的那只手，然后是任何写字的人，最后连笔也能被称作写者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person at a desk of crossed-out pages.
core.cn: 核心意象：坐在铺满涂改稿纸的书桌前的人。

branches.en: The profession branch: writing as a life and a trade.
branches.cn: 职业分支：以写作为生活与营生。

branches.en: The attribution branch: the single hand behind this letter.
branches.cn: 归属分支：这封信背后的那只手。

branches.en: The plain action branch: anyone who writes, author or not.
branches.cn: 动作分支：任何写字的人，不论是否作者。

branches.en: The tool branch: a pen judged by how it writes.
branches.cn: 工具分支：以写得好坏来评断的笔。

branches.en: The identity branch: from doing the work to being known by it.
branches.cn: 身份分支：从事这件事，到以此为人所知。

intro.en: Writer is a transparent compound of the verb write and the agent suffix -er, and further endings build on it.
intro.cn: writer 由动词 write 加施动后缀 -er 清晰构成，它本身还能再带后缀。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic, so the English word has no Latin ancestor; the Latin words below belong to the same old root family.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语，因此这个英语词没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁词同属那个古老词根家族。

items.exampleCN: 它把 write 变成 writer。

items.example: It gives writers for many of them.
It forms writerly, like a professional writer.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 writerly，有作家气派的。

items.example: It forms writership, the status of a writer.

items.meaning: a writer who writes for another name
items.example: The name on the cover is not the writer.
items.exampleCN: 封面上的名字并不是写的人。

items.example: Copy is the text of an advertisement.

definition_en: a feeling of deep sadness, or something that causes it
core_image: 一个人坐在窗边，手捧旧照片，久久不语
scene: 她听到消息后满怀悲伤。 She was filled with sorrow at the news.
sceneCN: 这里 sorrow 是「悲伤；悲痛」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她听到消息后满怀悲伤。

senses.title: Deep sadness
senses.definition: a feeling of deep sadness, especially after a loss
senses.definitionCN: 深深的悲伤，尤其在失去之后
senses.example: She was filled with sorrow at the news.
senses.exampleCN: 她听到消息后满怀悲伤。
senses.why: The old word named care and grief together.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的词同时指挂念与悲痛。

senses.title: A sad event
senses.definition: an event or situation that causes sadness
senses.definitionCN: 引起悲伤的事件或处境
senses.example: The family has known many sorrows.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人经历过许多不幸。
senses.why: The feeling and the cause of it share one word.
senses.whyCN: 悲伤的感受与引起悲伤的事共用一个词。

intro.en: Sorrow comes from an old word for care and grief.
intro.cn: sorrow 来自一个同时表示挂念与悲痛的古老词汇。

items.en: Sorg meant care, anxiety, or grief.
items.cn: sorg 意为挂念、忧虑或悲痛。

items.en: The form became sorwe and then sorrow.
items.cn: 词形先变为 sorwe，再变为 sorrow。

items.en: It narrowed to deep sadness.
items.cn: 它的含义缩小为深深的悲伤。

items.en: It also named events that cause sadness.
items.cn: 它也开始指引起悲伤的事件。

items.en: Sorrowful and sorrowfully extended the family.
items.cn: sorrowful 与 sorrowfully 扩展了这个词族。

note.en: Sorrow is compared with look-alike words and words for sadness.
note.cn: 把 sorrow 与形近词以及表示悲伤的词作比较。

entries.definition: feeling sad or regretful
small in width
to take and return later
deep sadness after a loss
the state of being sad
severe mental pain

normalIntro.en: Sorrow is grief that has settled in for a long stay.
normalIntro.cn: sorrow 是准备久住的悲痛。

normal.en: She was filled with sorrow at the news.
normal.cn: 她听到消息后满怀悲伤。

normal.en: The family has known many sorrows.
normal.cn: 这家人经历过许多不幸。

normal.en: He spoke of his loss with quiet sorrow.
normal.cn: 他平静而悲伤地谈起自己的失去。

normal.en: Joy and sorrow often arrive together.
normal.cn: 欢乐与悲伤常常一起到来。

normal.en: A sorrow shared becomes easier to bear.
normal.cn: 分担的悲伤会变得容易承受。

abstract.en: Sorrow is love with nowhere to go.
abstract.cn: 悲伤是无处可去的爱。

abstract.en: The heart learns depth by going down.
abstract.cn: 心是靠下沉才学会深度的。

abstract.en: What is mourned was once a gift.
abstract.cn: 被哀悼的东西，曾经是一份礼物。

examples.en: She was filled with sorrow at the news.
examples.cn: 她听到消息后满怀悲伤。

examples.en: The family has known many sorrows.
examples.cn: 这家人经历过许多不幸。

examples.en: He spoke of his loss with quiet sorrow.
examples.cn: 他平静而悲伤地谈起自己的失去。

dict_mnemonic.text: sorrow 与 sorry（难过的、抱歉的）同源：sorrow 是名词「悲伤」，sorrowful 是「悲伤的」；joy and sorrow 是「欢乐与悲伤」，in sorrow 是「在悲伤中」。

root: 来自古英语 sorg（挂念、忧虑、悲痛），核心义「深沉的悲伤与牵挂」。

sensesIntro.en: Sorrow means deep sadness, or an event that causes it.
sensesIntro.cn: sorrow 意为深深的悲伤，或引起悲伤的事件。

core.en: Sadness that stays.
core.cn: 停留不去的悲伤。

branches.en: A person sits quietly with an old photo.
branches.cn: 一个人拿着旧照片静静地坐着。

branches.en: A family remembers several hard years.
branches.cn: 一个家庭回忆着几段艰难的岁月。

branches.en: The feeling and the event are named by one word.
branches.cn: 感受与事件被同一个词命名。

branches.en: Shared sorrow grows lighter.
branches.cn: 分担的悲伤会变轻。

branches.en: What causes sorrow also proves what mattered.
branches.cn: 引起悲伤的事，也证明了什么曾重要。

intro.en: Sorrow builds a family of sad adjectives and adverbs.
intro.cn: sorrow 构成一组表示悲伤的形容词和副词。

latinIntro.en: Sorrow has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sorg.
latinIntro.cn: sorrow 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 sorg。

items.example: Her sorrow was plain to see.

items.exampleCN: 他独自承受着种种悲伤。

items.example: A sorrowful song filled the room.
items.exampleCN: 一首悲伤的歌充满了房间。

items.example: The sorrowfulness of the scene moved us.
items.exampleCN: 这场景的悲伤打动了我们。

items.example: I am sorry for the mistake.
items.exampleCN: 我为这个错误感到抱歉。

items.meaning: in a poor or sorry way

items.example: The sorriness of the road surprised us.
items.exampleCN: 这条路糟糕得让我们吃惊。

definition_en: the strength or degree of something such as heat, light, sound, or feeling
core_image: 调音台上的推子被推到顶，音量指示灯全部亮红
scene: 录音室墙上挂着一块表，指针随鼓声忽高忽低地跳动。 Engineers measure the intensity of the sound at the front row.
sceneCN: 这里 intensity 是「强度」（第 1 个义项：可衡量的强弱程度），句意为工程师测量前排声音的强度。画面里的物件：音量表、推子、指示灯。

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「强烈的」
由本词换后缀构成，义为「加强；加剧」
由同一词干构成，义为「集中的；密集的」
由 intensify 加 -ion 构成，义为「加强」

senses.title: Measured strength
senses.definition: the amount of energy carried by heat, light, or sound, which can be measured
senses.definitionCN: 热、光或声音所携带、可以测量的能量多少
senses.example: The intensity of the lamp was turned down for the evening reading.
senses.exampleCN: 晚上读书时把灯的亮度调低了。
senses.why: Latin intensus "stretched" plus -ity makes a noun of degree.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intensus「拉紧的」加 -ity 构成表示程度的抽象名词。

senses.title: Strength of feeling
senses.definition: the depth and force of an emotion or of an experience
senses.definitionCN: 情感或经历所具有的深度与力度
senses.example: The intensity of her grief surprised her friends.
senses.exampleCN: 她悲伤之深让朋友们吃惊。
senses.why: Feelings are treated like light: they can be dim or blinding.
senses.whyCN: 情感被当作光来对待：可以昏淡，也可以刺目。

senses.title: Serious effort
senses.definition: great concentration and effort in work, study, or sport
senses.definitionCN: 在工作、学习或运动中投入的高度专注与气力
senses.example: The team trained with an intensity it had never shown.
senses.exampleCN: 这支队伍以从未有过的强度训练。
senses.why: The word praises not long hours but the grip of full attention.
senses.whyCN: 这个词赞的不是时数长，而是全神贯注的紧握感。

senses.title: In physics
senses.definition: the power carried through a unit area or a unit solid angle
senses.definitionCN: 单位面积或单位立体角所通过的能量
senses.example: Laser intensity falls off with the square of distance.
senses.exampleCN: 激光强度随距离的平方下降。
senses.why: Physics made the everyday word exact: power divided by area.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把这个日常词精确化：能量除以面积。

intro.en: Intensity attaches the Latin ending -itas to intensus, the participle of intendere.
intro.cn: intensity 把拉丁词尾 -itas 加到 intendere 的分词 intensus 上。

items.en: Tendere "to stretch" with in- makes intendere, to strain towards.
items.cn: tendere「伸展」与 in- 构成 intendere「向前绷紧」。

items.en: Intensus, the participle, described anything pulled tight.
items.cn: 分词 intensus 形容任何被拉紧之物。

items.en: Late Latin intesitas named the quality of being stretched to a high degree.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 intesitas 指被拉到高度这一性质。

items.en: French intensité was borrowed by English scientists in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 十七世纪英国科学家借入了法语 intensité。

items.en: It became a measuring term in physics and a praise word for feeling and effort.
items.cn: 它在物理学中成为测量术语，也成为赞感受与投入的词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stretched root; the near-meaning group holds other words for strength.
note.cn: 形近组共享「绷紧」词根；近义组收表示力量的词。

entries.definition: The adjective; the feeling itself is intense.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，感受本身是强烈的。

entries.definition: Gathered on one point, as in intensive care.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，集中于一点，如加护病房。

entries.definition: The state of being stretched, or nervous strain.
General power, often of a person or a material.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，泛指力量，多形容人或材料。

entries.definition: Physical power that moves or breaks things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「力」，能推动或破坏的物理力量。

entries.definition: A step on a scale, the neutral word for amount.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「程度」，中性的量度说法。

normalIntro.en: The hooks attach the -ity of measurement to the tightened string.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把表示「度量」的 -ity 挂在绷紧的弦上。

normal.en: Intense is the adjective; intensity is the dial you can read.
normal.cn: intense 是形容词，intensity 是可以读出刻度的表盘。

normal.en: Light intensity, sound intensity, emotional intensity: all are amounts.
normal.cn: 光照强度、声音强度、情感强度，都是量。

normal.en: High intensity training is short and hard.
normal.cn: 高强度训练短而费力。

normal.en: The intensity of the storm grew after dark.
normal.cn: 天黑之后暴风雨的强度增大了。

normal.en: Turn the intensity down when the neighbours sleep.
normal.cn: 邻居睡觉时把强度调低。

abstract.en: Intensity is how bright a thing burns, not how long.
abstract.cn: 强度是烧得多亮，而不是烧得多久。

abstract.en: A small room can hold great intensity of feeling.
abstract.cn: 一间小屋也能盛下极浓的情感。

abstract.en: Measure the light, and you still have not measured the evening.
abstract.cn: 量出了光的强度，你仍没有量出那个夜晚。

examples.en: The intensity of the midday light hurt his eyes.
examples.cn: 正午光线的强度刺痛了他的眼睛。

examples.en: She spoke with an intensity that silenced the room.
examples.cn: 她说话时的强度让全场安静下来。

examples.en: Doctors lowered the intensity of the treatment after a week.
examples.cn: 一周后医生降低了治疗的强度。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因太深斯特」——绷得太深太紧，强度自然大

root: 拉丁语 tendere「伸展」→ intensus「拉紧的」→ 晚期拉丁语 intesitas「绷紧的性质」→ 法语 intensité → 英语 intensity。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: measurable power, depth of feeling, concentrated effort, and the physics term.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：可测的力量、情感的深度、集中的投入，以及物理术语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fader pushed to the top and lights burning red.
core.cn: 核心意象：推子推到顶端，指示灯全红。

branches.en: THE LAMP: brightness is turned up or down.
branches.cn: 台灯这条线：亮度可以调高调低。

branches.en: THE GRIEF: feeling is measured like light.
branches.cn: 悲伤这条线：情感像光一样被度量。

branches.en: THE TRAINING GROUND: effort is held at full grip.
branches.cn: 训练场这条线：用力维持在满握状态。

branches.en: THE LASER: power divided by area, made exact.
branches.cn: 激光这条线：能量除以面积，精确化。

branches.en: THE LINK: everyday and scientific strength share one word.
branches.cn: 连接线：日常与科学的强度共用一词。

intro.cn: intensity = in- + tens-「伸展」+ -ity「……的性质」。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intensus 与晚期形式 intesitas 均有记载。
