definition_zh: 广泛地；普遍地；大大地；相隔很远地
definition_en: over a large area or among many people, and also by a large amount
core_image: 一张地图上密密麻麻插满了小旗，旗子从最东边一直排到最西边
scene: 墙上挂着世界地图，同一种小旗从东边一路插到西边，几乎每个国家都有一面。 The method is now widely used in hospitals across the country.
sceneCN: 这里 widely 是「广泛地」（第 1 个义项：在大范围内或许多人中间）；句意为这种方法如今在全国各地的医院里广泛使用。地图上从东到西插满小旗，就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: In many places
senses.definition: in a large number of places or among a large number of people
senses.definitionCN: 在许多地方或许多人中间
senses.example: The method is now widely used in hospitals across the country.
senses.exampleCN: 这种方法如今在全国各地的医院里广泛使用。
senses.why: The adverb simply says that the adjective spreads over a large area of use.
senses.whyCN: 这个副词只是说明形容词所指的范围铺展到了很大的使用面上。

senses.title: By a large amount
senses.definition: by a large degree or difference, often before words such as different or vary
senses.definitionCN: 在程度上或差距上很大，常放在 different、vary 之前
senses.example: Prices vary widely between the two cities.
senses.exampleCN: 两个城市的价格差别很大。
senses.why: Here the width is in the difference rather than in space, and the gap itself is broad.
senses.whyCN: 这里的宽度在于差距而不在于空间，拉开的是差距本身。

senses.title: Over long distances
senses.definition: used of two things placed far apart from each other
senses.definitionCN: 形容两个事物彼此相距很远
senses.example: The two villages are widely separated by the marsh.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个村子被沼泽隔得很远。
senses.why: The physical sense stays intact when the adverb measures the gap between two points.
senses.whyCN: 当副词度量两点间的间隔时，物理意义仍然完好。

senses.title: To travel extensively
senses.definition: used with verbs such as travel or read to mean over a very large extent
senses.definitionCN: 与 travel、read 等动词连用，表示范围极广
senses.example: He has travelled widely in Asia and still keeps a diary.
senses.exampleCN: 他在亚洲游历甚广，至今仍写日记。
senses.why: Movement across a wide map was the first use of the word, and it is still the easiest to picture.
senses.whyCN: 横越大片地图的移动是这个词最早的用法，至今也是最容易想象的。

intro.en: Widely is wide plus the adverb ending -ly, and it appeared once wide had already acquired the sense of a range.
intro.cn: widely 是 wide 加副词词尾 -ly，产生于 wide 已具备「范围」之义之后。

items.en: Wid meant broad, and the adverb widlice meant over a wide space.
items.cn: wid 表示宽阔，副词 widlice 表示在宽阔的范围内。

items.en: The form shifted to widely, and it began to appear with verbs of spreading and travelling.
items.cn: 词形移向 widely，开始与传播、旅行一类动词连用。

items.en: With travel and reading it described a person of broad experience.
items.cn: 与 travel、read 连用时，它描述阅历广的人。

items.en: Technology and commerce gave it the fixed company of used, known and available.
items.cn: 科技与商业让它与 used、known、available 固定搭配。

items.en: Before words such as different and vary it came to mean by a large degree.
items.cn: 放在 different、vary 等词前，它就表示「在很大程度」。

note.en: The first group gathers other -ly adverbs that look similar, the second the words that stress breadth of use.
note.cn: 第一组收形近的其他 -ly 副词，第二组收强调使用广泛的词。

entries.definition: The adjective behind the adverb.
The noun of measurement.
The verb of making broader.
Cunning, with one letter fewer.
In most cases or among most people.
Over a large area or in great detail.
By many ordinary people.

normalIntro.en: Widely is the adverb of spread, so its best pictures are maps and crowds rather than measures.
normalIntro.cn: widely 是「铺开」的副词，所以它最好的画面是地图和人群，而不是尺子。

normal.en: Wide plus ly: the adjective becomes a way of happening.
normal.cn: wide 加 ly：形容词变成了一种发生的方式。

normal.en: Widely used and widely known are the two commonest pairs.
normal.cn: widely used 与 widely known 是最常见的两对搭配。

normal.en: Vary widely puts the width into the difference, not the map.
normal.cn: vary widely 把宽度放进了差别里，而不是地图上。

normal.en: Read widely means the books are spread out, not thick.
normal.cn: read widely 说明书读得广，而不是读得厚。

normal.en: Widely separated is the only one that keeps the old physical sense.
normal.cn: widely separated 是唯一保留古老物理意义的搭配。

abstract.en: See flags pushed into a map from edge to edge.
abstract.cn: 看见小旗从地图一边插到另一边。

abstract.en: Hear one word repeated in a hundred mouths.
abstract.cn: 听见一个词在一百张嘴中重复。

abstract.en: Feel a habit spread through a whole city in a season.
abstract.cn: 感觉一种习惯在一个季节里传遍整座城。

examples.en: The new vaccine is widely available in rural areas.
examples.cn: 这种新疫苗在农村地区也能广泛获得。

examples.en: Opinions on the plan differ widely among the staff.
examples.cn: 员工对这个计划的看法差别很大。

examples.en: She read widely before writing her first novel.
examples.cn: 写第一部小说之前，她读了大量书籍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「外的里」——从外面一直铺到里面，处处都有，就是广泛地。

root: 古英语 wid（宽阔）+ 副词词尾 -ly → 中古英语 widely → 现代英语 widely；同族有 wide、widen、widespread。

sensesIntro.en: The word says that something reaches many places, then measures a large difference, then the distance between two points, and finally the breadth of a person s travel.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词先说明某事到达许多地方，接着度量很大的差别，然后是两点之间的距离，最后是个人游历的广度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: flags pushed into a world map from one edge to the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：一面面小旗从地图的一边插到另一边。

branches.en: The spread branch: a method used in many hospitals.
branches.cn: 传播分支：许多医院都在用的方法。

branches.en: The difference branch: prices that vary widely.
branches.cn: 差别分支：价格相差很大。

branches.en: The distance branch: two villages far apart.
branches.cn: 距离分支：相隔很远的两个村子。

branches.en: The travel branch: a man who has travelled widely.
branches.cn: 游历分支：游历甚广的人。

branches.en: The degree branch: the same word for space and for amount.
branches.cn: 程度分支：空间与数量共用同一个词。

intro.en: Widely is a plain -ly adverb on wide, so its structure is the whole point: the suffix turns a measure into a manner.
intro.cn: widely 是加在 wide 上的普通 -ly 副词，它的结构就是全部要点：后缀把度量变成了方式。

latinIntro.en: The base is native Germanic, so there is no Latin source; the Latin entries below give the closest borrowed adverbs.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是本土日耳曼语，没有拉丁语来源；下面的拉丁条目给出最接近的借入副词。

items.example: Here the width is a gap.

latinEntries.example: It gives English latitude through the adjective.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 它经由形容词给出英语的 latitude。

definition_en: a very small living thing that can cause disease, or the first seed of an idea
core_image: 显微镜下一群微小的细菌在游动
scene: 用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。 Washing hands with soap removes germs.
sceneCN: 这里 germ 是「细菌；病菌」（第 1 个义项）；句意：用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。

senses.title: Tiny living cause
senses.definition: a very small living thing, especially one that causes disease
senses.definitionCN: 极小的生物，尤指引起疾病的微生物
senses.example: Washing hands with soap removes germs.
senses.exampleCN: 用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。
senses.why: The seed sense was borrowed for unseen living particles.
senses.whyCN: 「种子」的含义被借用来指看不见的活微粒。

senses.title: First seed of an idea
senses.definition: the first small beginning of an idea or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 想法或感情最初微小的开端
senses.example: There was a germ of truth in his story.
senses.exampleCN: 他的故事里有一点真实的萌芽。
senses.why: An idea starts as small as a seed.
senses.whyCN: 一个想法开始的时候，小得像一粒种子。

senses.title: Sprouting part
senses.definition: the part of a seed that can grow into a new plant
senses.definitionCN: 种子中能长成新植株的部分
senses.example: Wheat germ is rich in nutrients.
senses.exampleCN: 小麦胚芽富含营养。
senses.why: This is the oldest and most literal sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最古老也最字面的含义。

intro.en: Germ first meant a sprout and was later applied to microbes.
intro.cn: germ 最初指幼芽，后来被用来指微生物。

items.en: Germen meant a sprout, bud, or seed.
items.cn: germen 意为幼芽、芽或种子。

items.en: The word passed into French as germe.
items.cn: 这个词以 germe 的形式进入法语。

items.en: English used germ for the seed of a plant.
items.cn: 英语用 germ 指植物的种子。

items.en: It came to mean the beginning of an idea.
items.cn: 它逐渐指一个想法的开端。

items.en: The nineteenth century applied it to disease microbes.
items.cn: 十九世纪把它用于致病的微生物。

note.en: Germ is compared with look-alike words and words for tiny life and beginnings.
note.cn: 把 germ 与形近词以及表示微小生命和开端的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: A germ is a seed so small that only a microscope can find it.
normalIntro.cn: germ 是一粒小到只有显微镜才能找到的种子。

normal.en: Washing hands with soap removes germs.
normal.cn: 用肥皂洗手能冲走细菌。

normal.en: There was a germ of truth in his story.

normal.en: Wheat germ is rich in nutrients.
normal.cn: 小麦胚芽富含营养。

normal.en: Coughing can spread germs in a crowded room.
normal.cn: 咳嗽会在拥挤的房间里传播细菌。

normal.en: The germ of the plan came from a walk.
normal.cn: 这个计划的萌芽来自一次散步。

abstract.en: Every great idea begins as a germ no one else can see.
abstract.cn: 每一个伟大的想法，开始时都是一粒别人看不见的萌芽。

abstract.en: Small causes are still causes.
abstract.cn: 微小的原因仍然是原因。

abstract.en: A seed does not announce the tree.
abstract.cn: 种子从不预告它将长成的树。

examples.en: Wheat germ is rich in nutrients.

dict_mnemonic.text: germ 原本是「幼芽、种子」：疾病的「种子」就是病菌，想法的「种子」就是萌芽；germ theory 是「病菌学说」，a germ of 是「一点……的萌芽」。

root: 来自拉丁语 germen（幼芽、种子），经古法语 germe 进入英语，核心义「能长成新东西的小种子」。

sensesIntro.en: Germ means a disease-causing microbe, the first small beginning of an idea, or the sprouting part of a seed.
sensesIntro.cn: germ 意为致病的微生物、想法最初的开端，或种子的胚芽。

core.en: A tiny seed from which something grows.
core.cn: 一粒能长出东西的微小种子。

branches.en: Under a lens, tiny shapes swim in a drop.
branches.cn: 在镜头下，一滴水里游动着微小的形状。

branches.en: One small doubt sits at the edge of a plan.
branches.cn: 一点小小的怀疑停在计划的边缘。

branches.en: A green tip pushes out of the soil.
branches.cn: 一个绿色的尖端从土里探出来。

branches.en: Both the microbe and the sprout begin invisibly small.
branches.cn: 微生物和幼芽开始时都小得看不见。

branches.en: An idea and a plant both grow from a hidden start.
branches.cn: 想法和植物都从隐蔽的起点生长。

intro.en: Germ has a family of sprouting, seed, and killing words.
intro.cn: germ 有一个由发芽、种子与杀灭组成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin germen meant a sprout or bud.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 germen 意为幼芽或芽。

items.meaning: a microbe or a first seed
items.example: A germ can make you ill.

items.meaning: relating to a bud or early stage
items.exampleCN: 这个想法还处在萌芽阶段。
这种清洁剂含杀菌成分。

latinEntries.example: Germen is the source of germ.
latinEntries.exampleCN: germen 是 germ 的来源。
germinare 孕育了英语的 germinate。

definition_en: the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or large vehicle
core_image: 船舱里堆得满满的木箱
scene: 这艘船装载着一批木材。 The ship was carrying a cargo of timber.
sceneCN: 这里 cargo 是「货物」（第 1 个义项：船或飞机运载的一批货）；句意是这艘船装载着一批木材。

derivatives.zh: 语义关联词，义为「货运；货物」，常与 cargo 互换
语义关联词，义为「装运的一批货」
语义关联词，义为「负载；装载量」

senses.title: Goods carried by a ship or aircraft
senses.definition: the goods that a ship, aircraft, or large vehicle carries
senses.definitionCN: 船、飞机或大型车辆所运载的货物
senses.example: The port handles cargo from all over the world.
senses.exampleCN: 这个港口处理来自世界各地的货物。
senses.why: Spanish cargo meant a loading or a burden, and English kept that sense of goods loaded aboard.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语 cargo 意为「装载、负担」，英语保留了「装到船上的货」这一含义。

senses.title: The full load a carrier can take
senses.definition: the total amount of goods that a ship or aircraft is carrying or can carry
senses.definitionCN: 一艘船或一架飞机所载或能载的货物总量
senses.example: The vessel returned with a full cargo of grain.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船满载谷物返航。
senses.why: If cargo is what is loaded, then a full cargo names the complete load, not just some goods.
senses.whyCN: 既然 cargo 是装上的货，那么 a full cargo 就指完整的载货量，而不只是部分货物。

intro.en: Cargo comes from a Spanish word for loading, and behind it stands the Latin wagon.
intro.cn: cargo 来自西班牙语中表示「装载」的词，背后仍是拉丁语的「车」。

items.en: carrus named a wagon, the base of a whole family of loading words.
items.cn: carrus 指马车，是整组「装载」词汇的基础。

items.en: carricare meant to load a wagon or a cart.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 carricare 意为「往车上装货」。

items.en: cargo named a load or a burden, especially the goods on a ship.
items.cn: 西班牙语 cargo 指负载或负担，尤指船上的货物。

items.en: English borrowed cargo through trade for the goods carried by a vessel.
items.cn: 英语通过贸易借入 cargo，指船只运载的货物。

items.en: The word extended to aircraft and lorries, and to air cargo as a fixed phrase.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到飞机和货车，并形成 air cargo 这样的固定说法。

note.en: Cargo belongs to the Latin wagon family and sits beside freight and shipment.
note.cn: cargo 属于拉丁语「车」词族，同时与 freight、shipment 相邻。

entries.definition: to ask a price, or to load something with a task or duty
entries.definitionCN: 收费，或使承担任务；与 cargo 同出 carricare（装车）。

entries.definition: a vehicle for passengers, or the act of carrying
entries.definitionCN: 载客车厢，或运送行为，与 cargo 同根。

entries.definition: a person or company that transports goods
entries.definitionCN: 运输货物的人或公司，与 cargo 同根。

entries.definition: goods carried by ship, train, or lorry
entries.definitionCN: 由船、火车或卡车运载的货物，常与 cargo 互换。

entries.definition: a load of goods sent together
the amount carried by a vehicle
entries.definitionCN: 车辆所载的量，是 cargo 的上位说法。

normalIntro.en: The word is about loading: cargo is what gets loaded onto a ship.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词的核心是「装载」：cargo 就是被装到船上的货。

normal.en: cargo comes from Spanish cargar, to load, and behind it Latin carrus, a wagon.
normal.cn: cargo 来自西班牙语 cargar（装载），背后是拉丁语 carrus（车）。

normal.en: cargo ship and cargo plane name the carriers built for goods only.
normal.cn: cargo ship 与 cargo plane 指专门运货的船和飞机。

normal.en: a cargo of timber treats cargo as a countable unit when the goods are named.
normal.cn: a cargo of timber 说明当具体货物被点明时，cargo 可以作可数单位。

normal.en: cargo hold is the space inside the ship where the goods sit.
normal.cn: cargo hold 是船内堆放货物的空间，即货舱。

normal.en: The plural cargoes keeps the older -es ending.
normal.cn: 复数 cargoes 保留了较旧的 -es 结尾。

abstract.en: Picture a hold packed with wooden boxes roped down for a storm.
abstract.cn: 想象货舱塞满木箱，为防风暴用绳子固定。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lifting one container from dock to deck.
abstract.cn: 想象起重机把一个集装箱从码头吊到甲板。

abstract.en: Picture a plane with no windows, only a wide loading door.
abstract.cn: 想象一架没有窗户、只有宽大装货门的飞机。

examples.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of timber.
examples.cn: 这艘船装载着一批木材。

examples.en: The port handles cargo from all over the world.
examples.cn: 这个港口处理来自世界各地的货物。

examples.en: The vessel returned with a full cargo of grain.
examples.cn: 这艘船满载谷物返航。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡够」——货装得卡够了位置，就是船上的货。

root: 拉丁语 carrus（车）→ 晚期拉丁语 carricare（装车）→ 西班牙语 cargo（装载）→ 英语 cargo。

sensesIntro.en: Goods and the amount of goods: cargo names both what is loaded and the whole load.
sensesIntro.cn: 货物与货物总量：cargo 既指装上船的货，也指整船的量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ship's hold filled with roped wooden boxes.
core.cn: 核心意象：船舱里塞满用绳固定的木箱。

branches.en: The goods sense: what a ship or aircraft carries.
branches.cn: 货物义：船或飞机运载的东西。

branches.en: The quantity sense: a full load taken as one unit.
branches.cn: 数量义：把满满一船货当成一个整体。

branches.en: cargo ship and cargo plane name vehicles built for goods.
branches.cn: 货船与货机指专为货物建造的运输工具。

branches.en: Both senses keep the idea of loading onto a carrier.
branches.cn: 两个义项都保留了「往运输工具上装」的想法。

branches.en: a full cargo marks the maximum a vessel can take.
branches.cn: a full cargo 标记的是一艘船能装的上限。

intro.en: Cargo is a borrowed base noun, and its family comes through the loading root.
intro.cn: cargo 是借入的基础名词，词族经由「装载」这一词根展开。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus and carricare link cargo with charge, carriage, and carrier.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carrus 与 carricare 把 cargo 和 charge、carriage、carrier 连在一起。

items.meaning: goods carried by ship or aircraft
items.example: The cargo was unloaded at dawn.

items.meaning: to load with a duty, or to ask a price

items.meaning: the act of carrying, or a passenger vehicle

definition_zh: 乐趣；娱乐；消遣活动；游乐设施
definition_en: the feeling of finding something funny, or an activity or place that entertains people
core_image: 旋转木马转起来，人群的笑声跟着起伏
scene: 游乐园里旋转木马转个不停，孩子笑出声。 The amusement park stayed open until midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 amusement 是「娱乐；游乐」（第 2 个义项：供人消遣娱乐的活动或场所）；句意为这座游乐园一直开到午夜。

pos.zh: 名词：乐趣；娱乐；消遣活动；游乐设施

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「逗乐；给……提供消遣」
由 amuse 加 -ed 构成，义为「被逗乐的」
由 amuse 加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的」
由 amusing 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣地」

senses.title: The feeling of finding something funny
senses.definition: the pleasant feeling caused by something funny or lightly entertaining
senses.definitionCN: 由有趣或轻松娱乐的事物引起的愉快感受
senses.example: She watched the argument with quiet amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 她饶有兴致地安静看着这场争论。
senses.why: The noun adds -ment to the verb amuse: the state left behind when attention has been pleasantly occupied.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词在动词 amuse 后加 -ment：注意力被愉快占据后留下的状态。

senses.title: An entertaining activity or place
senses.definition: something organized to entertain people, such as a game, show, or park
senses.definitionCN: 为娱乐人们而组织的事物，如游戏、演出或公园
senses.example: The town fair offers amusements for every age.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上的集市为每个年龄的人提供消遣。
senses.why: The feeling can be packaged: a ride or a game is a machine for producing that pleasant state.
senses.whyCN: 这种感受可以被包装：一项游乐设施或游戏，就是生产那种愉快状态的机器。

senses.title: Light diversion from serious work
senses.definition: a light activity that gives relief from work or boredom
senses.definitionCN: 使人从工作或无聊中得到缓解的轻松活动
senses.example: He reads detective novels purely for amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 他读侦探小说纯粹为了消遣。
senses.why: Amusement can also be the small door out of a serious day, not a grand entertainment but relief.
senses.whyCN: amusement 也可以是从严肃一天里逃出的一扇小门，不是盛大娱乐，而是缓解。

intro.en: Amusement is the noun built on amuse, and it names both the feeling and the machinery that produces it.
intro.cn: amusement 是建立在 amuse 之上的名词，既命名感受，也命名制造感受的装置。

items.en: Amuser meant 'to occupy or divert the attention', the verb behind the noun.
items.cn: amuser 意为「占据或转移注意力」，是名词背后的动词。

items.en: The French suffix -ment turned the verb into a noun of state or result.
items.cn: 法语后缀 -ment 把动词变成表示状态或结果的名词。

items.en: English amusement is recorded from the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语 amusement 自十七世纪有记录。

items.en: The first sense is the pleasant state of being entertained.
items.cn: 第一个义项是被娱乐时的愉快状态。

items.en: The second sense moved from the feeling to the rides, games and parks that produce it.
items.cn: 第二个义项从感受移向产生感受的游乐设施、游戏与公园。

items.en: Amusement park fixed the public-place sense in the twentieth century.
items.cn: amusement park 在二十世纪固定了「公共场所」这一义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the amuse family; the near-meaning group gathers fun and entertainment nouns.
note.cn: 形近组收 amuse 词族；近义组收乐趣与娱乐类名词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to entertain or make laugh.
Funny and lightly entertaining.
Confused or puzzled rather than entertained.
entries.definitionCN: 指困惑、茫然，而非被逗乐。

entries.definition: Organized activity that entertains an audience.
entries.definitionCN: 指娱乐观众的有组织活动。

entries.definition: Enjoyment and light pleasure.
The pleasure taken in an activity.
entries.definitionCN: 指从活动中获得的愉悦。

entries.definition: Something that turns attention away pleasantly.
entries.definitionCN: 指愉快地转移注意力的事物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from the feeling in a face to the park that manufactures it.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从脸上的感受，移到制造这种感受的游乐园。

normal.en: Amusement is the -ment of amuse: the state left after the laugh.
normal.cn: amusement 是 amuse 加 -ment：笑声过后留下的状态。

normal.en: To my amusement means the laugh happened to me.
normal.cn: to my amusement 意为好笑发生在我身上。

normal.en: An amusement park is a factory for that state.
normal.cn: 游乐园就是生产这种状态的工厂。

normal.en: Amusement arcade puts the same word in a room full of machines.
normal.cn: amusement arcade 把同一个词放进一间装满机器的屋子。

normal.en: Pure amusement means no work is hiding behind it.
normal.cn: pure amusement 意为背后没有藏着工作。

abstract.en: Picture a child's face at the top of a turning carousel.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子在旋转木马最高处的脸。

abstract.en: Now picture the same smile drawn on a ticket booth.
abstract.cn: 再想象同样的微笑被画在售票亭上。

abstract.en: The face and the booth are the two senses of amusement.
abstract.cn: 那张脸与售票亭，就是 amusement 的两个义项。

examples.en: The children shouted with amusement at the puppet show.
examples.cn: 孩子们看木偶戏时乐得直叫。

examples.en: The seaside town has a small amusement park.
examples.cn: 这座海滨小镇有一座小游乐园。

examples.en: To my amusement, the cat slept in the box meant for the dog.
examples.cn: 令我好笑的是，猫睡进了给狗准备的箱子。

root: 法语 amuser（占据注意力）+ 名词后缀 -ment，十七世纪进入英语；由「被娱乐的状态」扩展为「娱乐活动、游乐设施」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the inner feeling, to the activity that produces it, to the light relief it gives.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从内心感受，到产生它的活动，再到它带来的轻松缓解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a carousel turns and the laughter of the crowd rises with it.
core.cn: 核心意象：旋转木马转动，人群的笑声随之起伏。

branches.en: THE FEELING: the first sense is the inner pleasant state.
branches.cn: 感受线：第一个义项是内心的愉快状态。

branches.en: THE PARK: the second sense is the place or ride that produces it.
branches.cn: 游园线：第二个义项是产生这种状态的地方或设施。

branches.en: THE RELIEF: the third sense is the small door out of a serious day.
branches.cn: 缓解线：第三个义项是从严肃一天里逃出的小门。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: feeling and park are the product and the factory.
branches.cn: 机器线：感受与游乐园是产品与工厂。

branches.en: THE ESCAPE: laughter and relief both loosen a tight day.
branches.cn: 逃离线：笑声与缓解都让紧绷的一天松开。

intro.cn: amusement 是 amuse 词族的名词，条目收集动词、形容词与常用框架。

latinIntro.en: The word came through French, so no direct Latin entry is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经法语传来，因此不列直接拉丁条目。

items.exampleCN: 这个消息引起很大乐趣。

items.example: The amusement park opens at ten.
They met in an amusement arcade.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家游戏厅见面。

items.meaning: in a way that I found funny
items.example: To my amusement, the dog answered the phone.
items.exampleCN: 令我好笑的是，狗接了电话。

definition_en: the act of noticing or finding something that is hidden or hard to see
core_image: 黑屋里一束紫外光扫过，原本看不见的痕迹忽然亮起来
scene: 海关人员把行李放上扫描台，屏幕上浮出一个不该有的轮廓。 The detection of the hidden compartment took only a minute.
sceneCN: 这里 detection 指「发现」（第 2 个义项：查出故意藏起来的东西）；句意是发现那个暗格只用了一分钟。

senses.title: Noticing something not obvious
senses.definition: the act of noticing something that is present but not easy to see
senses.definitionCN: 注意到某物存在，但它并不容易看见
senses.example: His detection of the small error saved the whole experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 他察觉到那个小错误，救下了整个实验。
senses.why: The thing was already there; only attention had to arrive.
senses.whyCN: 东西本来就在，缺的只是那份注意。

senses.title: Finding something concealed
senses.definition: the act of discovering something that someone has deliberately hidden
senses.definitionCN: 把别人故意藏起来的东西查出来
senses.example: The detection of the hidden compartment took only a minute.
senses.exampleCN: 发现那个暗格只用了一分钟。
senses.why: A cover is only useful while nobody thinks to lift it.
senses.whyCN: 遮盖只在没人想到去掀开时才有用。

senses.title: Testing for a substance
senses.definition: the use of a device or test to learn whether something is present
senses.definitionCN: 用仪器或测试判断某种东西是否存在
senses.example: Sensitive detection is needed for traces this small.
senses.exampleCN: 这么微小的痕迹需要高灵敏度的检测。
senses.why: The human eye is handed over to a machine that never blinks.
senses.whyCN: 人眼被交给一台从不眨眼的机器。

intro.en: Detection comes from Latin detegere, to uncover, built from de-, away, and tegere, to cover, and it reached English through French.
intro.cn: detection 来自拉丁语 detegere，本义是揭开覆盖，由 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）构成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Tegere meant to cover, and detegere meant to take the cover off.
items.cn: tegere 指覆盖，detegere 指把覆盖物拿开。

items.en: The participle detectus described anything laid bare to the eye.
items.cn: 分词 detectus 形容任何被摊在眼前的东西。

items.en: English detect first meant to expose a hidden fact.
items.cn: 英语 detect 最初指揭发一桩隐藏的事实。

items.en: Police work gave detection the sense of catching criminals.
items.cn: 警务工作让 detection 带上抓罪犯的意思。

items.en: Science now uses it for finding traces too small to see.
items.cn: 如今科学用它指找出小到看不见的痕迹。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tect shape, while the meaning group runs from finding to recognizing and showing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 tect 这一段，近义组则从找到一路走到认出与显露。

entries.definition: a person whose job is to investigate crimes
entries.definitionCN: 以调查案件为职业的人

entries.definition: a device that senses something
to keep someone or something safe from harm
the act of finding something for the first time
the act of recognizing what something is
the act of making something visible

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a cover lifted off a hidden mark and end with a machine reading traces.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从揭开盖住痕迹的布开始，落到读出痕迹的机器。

normal.en: De- takes the cover away, and tegere is the cover itself.
normal.cn: de- 把盖子拿走，tegere 就是那层盖子。

normal.en: A detective is simply a person whose job is to uncover.
normal.cn: detective 不过是把揭示当作职业的人。

normal.en: Early detection means the mark is still small enough to handle.
normal.cn: 早发现，意味着痕迹还小到能处理。

normal.en: A smoke alarm is detection without a nose.
normal.cn: 烟雾报警器是没有鼻子的探测。

normal.en: What is covered wants a light, not a louder shout.
normal.cn: 被盖住的东西需要的是一束光，而不是更大的喊声。

abstract.en: Picture a finger lifting one corner of a cloth.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指掀起布的一角。

abstract.en: Picture a thin beam crossing a dark room.
abstract.cn: 想象一束细光扫过黑屋。

abstract.en: Picture a print glowing faintly blue on glass.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚指纹在玻璃上泛出淡蓝的光。

examples.en: Early detection of the disease saves many lives.
examples.cn: 及早发现这种病能救很多人的命。

examples.en: The detection of the leak prevented a serious fire.
examples.cn: 发现那处泄漏避免了一场大火。

examples.en: Modern instruments can find traces that eyes miss.
examples.cn: 现代仪器能找出眼睛漏掉的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 detection 记成「地泰克神」：de 是去掉，tect 像「盖」，把盖子去掉，就是发现与检测。

root: 来自拉丁语 detegere，由 de-（去掉）与 tegere（覆盖）组成，经法语进入英语。本义是揭开覆盖物让东西露出来，后来用于揭发隐秘之事、侦破案件，也用于仪器检测。

sensesIntro.en: From an eye catching a faint mark, to uncovering what was hidden on purpose, to a machine that senses for us.
sensesIntro.cn: 从眼睛捕捉一道淡痕，到揭出故意藏起的东西，再到替我们感知的机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted off something that was meant to stay hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：盖住某物的布被掀开，而那东西本想一直藏着。

chain: A COVER LIES ON A MARK
A CRIME IS BROUGHT TO LIGHT

branches.en: The first sense is an eye noticing what was not meant to be seen.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是眼睛注意到本不想被看见的东西。

branches.en: The second sense adds intention: someone hid it and someone finds it.
branches.cn: 第二个义项添上意图：有人藏，有人找出来。

branches.en: The third sense hands the noticing over to an instrument.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这份注意交给仪器。

branches.en: Noticing and uncovering are one act, once passive and once purposeful.
branches.cn: 察觉与揭发是同一个动作，一个被动，一个有意。

branches.en: A detective and a detector answer the same question: is it there?
branches.cn: 侦探与探测器回答同一个问题：它在那儿吗？

intro.en: Detection gathers a family of words about uncovering, sensing and the people who investigate.
intro.cn: detection 聚起一族词，围绕揭开、感知以及查案的人。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin tegere, to cover, and de- reverses it into uncovering.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 tegere（覆盖），前缀 de- 把它反转成揭开。

items.meaning: the act of uncovering or sensing

items.exampleCN: 查出这个故障花了几个小时。

这种气体几乎察觉不到。

items.example: The error went undetected for years.
items.exampleCN: 这个错误多年未被发现。

items.example: Several detections were recorded that night.
items.exampleCN: 那晚记录下了几次发现。

definition_en: a ship driven by steam, or a container used for steaming food
core_image: 一艘烟囱冒汽的旧式轮船
scene: 汽船缓缓驶入港口。 The steamer sailed slowly into the port.
sceneCN: 这里 steamer 是「汽船」（第 1 个义项）；句意：汽船缓缓驶入港口。

senses.title: Steam ship
senses.definition: a ship powered by a steam engine
senses.definitionCN: 由蒸汽机驱动的船
senses.example: The steamer sailed slowly into the port.
senses.exampleCN: 汽船缓缓驶入港口。
senses.why: This is the historic travel sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是历史上最典型的交通义项。

senses.title: Steaming pot
senses.definition: a pot or basket in which food is cooked by steam
senses.definitionCN: 用蒸汽烹制食物的锅或笼
senses.example: She put the buns in the steamer.
senses.exampleCN: 她把包子放进蒸笼。

senses.whyCN: 推动船只的蒸汽，也用来蒸食物。

senses.title: One who steams
senses.definition: a person or device that steams something
senses.definitionCN: 蒸制某物的人或装置
senses.example: The steamer works by the window.
senses.exampleCN: 那位蒸制师傅在窗边干活。
senses.why: The -er suffix can name a person as well as a thing.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -er 既可指物，也可指人。

intro.en: Steamer is steam plus the agent suffix -er, naming a ship or a pot that works by steam.
intro.cn: steamer 是 steam 加施事后缀 -er，指靠蒸汽工作的船或锅。

items.en: Steam named rising vapour.
items.cn: steam 指上升的水汽。

items.en: The suffix -er named a thing that acts.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 指施行动作的物。

items.en: Steamer first named a steam ship.
items.cn: steamer 最早指蒸汽船。

items.en: The word later named a cooking pot.
items.cn: 这个词后来也指蒸锅。

items.en: Travel by steamer faded as engines changed.
items.cn: 随着动力更新，乘汽船出行逐渐减少。

note.en: Steamer is compared with look-alike words and with words for ships and pots.

sensesIntro.en: A steamer is a steam-powered ship, a steaming pot, or one that steams.

core.en: A thing driven by steam.
core.cn: 靠蒸汽驱动的东西。

branches.en: A funnel smokes above a river boat.
branches.cn: 内河船的烟囱冒着烟。

branches.en: A lid lifts over a basket of dumplings.
branches.cn: 蒸笼盖在一笼饺子上被掀开。

branches.en: Hands lift hot food from a rack.
branches.cn: 双手从架子上取下滚烫的食物。

branches.en: The engine and the pot share one source.
branches.cn: 引擎与锅，共用同一个来源。

branches.en: A pot steams only because someone steams.
branches.cn: 锅会冒汽，是因为有人在蒸。

intro.en: Steamer adds -er to steam and takes a plain plural.
intro.cn: steamer 由 steam 加 -er 构成，复数直接加 -s。

definition_en: the hot glowing gas of a fire, a strong feeling of passion, or to burn brightly
core_image: 烛芯顶端一跳一跳的橙色火舌
scene: 蜡烛的火苗在风里摇得很厉害。 The flame of the candle shook in the wind.
sceneCN: 这里 flame 是「火焰」（第 1 个义项）；句意：蜡烛的火苗在风里摇得很厉害。

senses.title: Burning gas
senses.definition: the bright burning gas that rises from a fire
senses.definitionCN: 从火中升起的明亮燃烧气体
senses.example: The flame of the candle shook in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 蜡烛的火苗在风里摇晃。
senses.why: This is the physical sense seen every day.
senses.whyCN: 这是每天都能看到的物理义项。

senses.title: Fire
senses.definition: fire, especially when it is burning strongly
senses.definitionCN: 火，尤指燃烧猛烈时
senses.example: Dry wood burst into flames.
senses.exampleCN: 干柴突然燃烧起来。
senses.why: The plural flames often names a whole fire.
senses.whyCN: 复数 flames 常指一整片火。

senses.title: Passion
senses.definition: a strong feeling of love or enthusiasm
senses.definitionCN: 强烈的爱意或热情
senses.example: The flame of ambition still burned in her.
senses.exampleCN: 她心中雄心之火仍在燃烧。
senses.why: Heat became a metaphor for strong feeling.
senses.whyCN: 热度被隐喻为强烈的情感。

senses.title: To burn
senses.definition: to burn with bright flames
senses.definitionCN: 冒出明亮火焰地燃烧
senses.example: The logs flamed in the fireplace.
senses.exampleCN: 木柴在壁炉里燃烧。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb of burning.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示燃烧的动词。

intro.en: Flame goes back through Old French to Latin flamma, a flame, from flare, to blow.
intro.cn: flame 经古法语上溯到拉丁语 flamma（火焰），源于 flare（吹）。

items.en: Flamma meant a flame or blazing fire.
items.cn: flamma 意为火焰或熊熊烈火。

items.en: The verb flare meant to blow or puff.
items.cn: 动词 flare 意为吹气、喷出。

items.en: Flambe carried the word into French.
items.cn: flambe 把这个词带入法语。

items.en: Flame named the burning gas of fire.
items.cn: flame 指火中燃烧的气体。

items.en: The word also became a metaphor for passion.
items.cn: 这个词也成为激情的隐喻。

note.en: Flame is compared with similar-looking words and with words for fire and light.
note.cn: 把 flame 与形近词以及表示火与光的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Flame is the visible tongue of fire, and by metaphor the heat of feeling.
normalIntro.cn: flame 是火可见的舌头，也比喻感情的炽热。

normal.en: A candle burns with a small flame.
normal.cn: 蜡烛燃着一小簇火苗。

normal.en: The house was in flames.
normal.cn: 房子陷入火海。

normal.en: The flame of love can fade.
normal.cn: 爱的火焰会减弱。

normal.en: The logs flamed brightly.
normal.cn: 木柴烧得火光熊熊。

normal.en: An old flame is a former lover.
normal.cn: old flame 指旧情人。

abstract.en: A flame needs fuel, air, and a beginning.
abstract.cn: 火焰需要燃料、空气和一个开端。

abstract.en: Heat without light is still real.
abstract.cn: 没有光的热依然真实。

abstract.en: Passion burns by the same grammar as fire.
abstract.cn: 激情与火遵循同一套燃烧语法。

examples.en: The flame of the candle shook in the wind.
examples.cn: 蜡烛的火苗在风里摇晃。

examples.en: Dry wood burst into flames.
examples.cn: 干柴突然燃烧起来。

examples.en: An old flame of hers called last night.
examples.cn: 她的旧情人昨晚打来电话。

dict_mnemonic.text: flame 源自拉丁语 flamma（火焰），与 flare（吹）同源，核心是「被吹旺的火」。

root: 源自拉丁语 flamma（火焰），与 flare（吹）同源，核心义「燃起的亮火」。

sensesIntro.en: Flame means a tongue of fire, a strong fire, passion, or to burn brightly.
sensesIntro.cn: flame 意为火苗、烈火、激情或熊熊燃烧。

core.en: Bright burning gas with heat and light.
core.cn: 带光带热的明亮燃烧气体。

branches.en: The visible tongue of a fire.
branches.cn: 火可见的舌头。

branches.en: A whole body of burning material.
branches.cn: 一整片燃烧的物质。

branches.en: Heat felt as strong emotion.
branches.cn: 以强烈情感形式感受到的热。

branches.en: The action of giving bright fire.
branches.cn: 发出明亮火焰的动作。

branches.en: Fire and feeling share the image of heat.
branches.cn: 火与情感共享热的意象。

intro.en: Flame belongs to the Latin flamm- family of burning words.
intro.cn: flame 属于拉丁语 flamm- 这一表示燃烧的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin flamma and flammare are the direct ancestors of the flaming family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 flamma 与 flammare 是这一词族的直接来源。

items.example: A flaming torch lit the way.
items.exampleCN: 一支燃烧的火把照亮了路。

items.example: Keep the gas away from flammable things.
The suit is made of nonflammable cloth.
items.exampleCN: 这套衣服用不易燃的布料做成。

items.example: The pan has a flameproof handle.
The chef made a flambe dessert.
items.exampleCN: 厨师做了一道火焰甜点。

latinEntries.example: Flamma is the Latin word for flame.
latinEntries.exampleCN: flamma 是拉丁语中的「火焰」。

latinEntries.example: Flammare meant to kindle a fire.
